hook: Damned wolves have been sniffing around my forge at night. Scared off two apprentices already. You look capable with that blade—care to earn some coin and my gratitude?

description: A giant has wandered too close to the farms outside Whiterun's walls, scattering livestock and terrorizing the farmers. Irileth needs someone to drive it back before the Jarl is forced to commit the city guard.
hook: The Jarl's patience wears thin. That lumbering oaf has crushed two fences already. I'd handle it myself, but my place is at the Jarl's side. See that it retreats—permanently or otherwise.

hook: Everything's for sale, my friend! Except, apparently, that warehouse in Riften. Bloody spiders think they own the place. I'd consider it a personal favor if you'd... renegotiate their lease.

hook: The Draugr are fascinating specimens, really—ancient Nords preserved by magic and ritual. Less fascinating when they're trying to split your skull. Clear a path for my expedition, and I'll compensate you with something considerably more valuable than gratitude.

hook: It was my mother's ring. The only thing I have left of her. Mikael was here yesterday, pestering me again, and now it's gone. I can't prove it was him, but... please, I just want it back.

hook: Here's the thing, lad/lass. Maven's been a friend to the Guild, but she's got something that belongs to us. A little shard of something... special. We'd like it back. And since she won't hand it over willingly, we need someone with quick fingers and quiet feet.

hook: That little shit Sibbi took something from me. A ring. Sentimental value. I want it back, and I don't care how you get it. He's been bragging about it at the Bee and Barb. Shut him up for good, and the ring's yours to return.

hook: Years ago, a job went sideways and a ring disappeared. Turns out Ulfberth up in Whiterun's been wearing it on his fat finger ever since. Maven wants it. I want Maven happy. You want coin. Everyone wins except Ulfberth.

hook: Ancano has... sticky fingers. One of our staves has gone missing, and I have little doubt where it's ended up. I can't confront him directly without causing problems with the Thalmor. But you—you're not bound by College politics. Retrieve it. Quietly.

description: Kodlak Whitemane is traveling to a sacred grove to meditate, and the Companions have heard whispers that the Silver Hand may try to ambush him. Guard the Harbinger on his journey and ensure he returns safely.
hook: The old man's going to the grove—won't let any of us come. Says it's a 'personal journey.' But we've heard the Silver Hand are sniffing around. Follow him. Keep your distance. But if anyone so much as looks at him wrong, you know what to do.

description: Maven Black-Briar is meeting with a contact from out of town, and the Guild has been hired to ensure her safety. Rumor has it a rival merchant has put a price on her head. Stand guard during the meeting and deal with any... interruptions.
hook: Maven's our biggest patron, and someone wants her dead. Normally I'd say let the snakes eat each other, but she pays better than the competition. Keep her breathing through this meeting, and there's a nice cut in it for you.

description: Onmund is conducting field research in Morthal Swamp, gathering samples from the dangerous marshlands. The College wants someone to watch his back while he's distracted by his work. Wisps and spiders make for poor research assistants.
hook: Young Onmund's enthusiasm outweighs his survival instincts. He's in the swamp collecting specimens, utterly oblivious to the things that want to eat him. Keep him alive long enough to finish his research. Consider it practice for more dangerous assignments.

description: Farkas is heading into Markarth Depths to clear out a Forsworn camp that's been raiding trade routes. Vilkas can't accompany him due to an injury. The Companions need someone to watch his back in those treacherous depths.
hook: Vilkas took an arrow in the last job—nothing serious, but he's out. Farkas is going alone, and while he's tough as an old boot, even he can get overwhelmed. Go with him. Make sure my brother comes back in one piece.

description: Astrid is performing a ritual at the ancient stones in Falkreath Graveyard, and during this time she'll be vulnerable. The Brotherhood wants someone to stand watch and ensure no... interruptions occur. The Silver Hand has been asking questions.
hook: I'll be... occupied. Vulnerable. The ritual requires my complete focus. Someone needs to watch the perimeter. Anyone approaches who isn't Family, you know what to do. Sithis demands this be done without complication.

description: The Silver Hand has been growing bold, harassing travelers near Whiterun's borders. Jarl Balgruuf wants to send a message without committing to open conflict. Raid one of their camps and remind them that Whiterun is not to be trifled with.
hook: I cannot openly declare war on every band of cutthroats that tests my borders. But I can ensure they remember why they fear the Hold. Hit one of their camps. Hard. Make sure survivors crawl back with stories.

description: The Silver Hand raided a College archaeological site and made off with several valuable texts. Urag gro-Shub doesn't care about the books—they were duplicates—but he cares deeply about the principle. He wants you to raid their camp and destroy their supplies as retaliation.
hook: They took books. My books. Well, the College's books. Duplicates, admittedly, but that's beside the point. The principle of the matter is that no one steals from the Arcanaeum. Go to their camp. Break their things. Leave a note explaining why.

hook: Some upstart werewolf hunters think they can sell skooma in my city. My city. I want their operation dismantled, their product destroyed, and their people reminded who truly runs Riften's underworld. Do this, and I'll remember the favor.

hook: They hunt us like animals. Call us beasts. They've killed shield-brothers and sisters I've known for decades. I've found one of their holes. I want it purged. Every last one of them. Show them what it truly means to be hunted.

hook: They took someone from me. Years ago, before the Guild, before Mercer. I've waited a long time for this. Their operation in the Depths—I want it crippled. Don't just kill them. Destroy their supplies, their weapons, their will to continue.

hook: Miss Carlotta made sweetrolls today. They smell so good. I'm so hungry. Could you... could you get one for me? I can't reach the window. Please?

hook: Ulfberth has a private stock of Honningbrew's finest. Aged ten years, they say. He won't sell it—keeps it for 'special occasions.' I'm a bard. Every night is a special occasion. Liberate a few bottles for me, would you?

hook: Farengar has a Grand Soul Gem—pristine quality, I'm told. He uses it as a paperweight, if you can believe it. Such a waste. I could do so much more with it. Retrieve it for me, and I'll share the results of my research.

hook: Maven's been getting too comfortable. Thinks she owns us. I want a look at her real ledger—the one she doesn't show the tax collectors. There's also a shiny trinket she uses as a bookmark. Bring me both. Consider it an investment in the Guild's future.

hook: I have a client—pays well, asks no questions. He wants a Staff of Frostbite. Old Festus down in Falkreath has one. I don't care how you get it, just get it. The Brotherhood won't miss one old man's walking stick. Probably.

hook: Ulfric sits in his palace, belly full, while we beg for scraps. It ain't right. You look like you can handle yourself. Sneak into his kitchens, grab what you can carry. Share it with those who truly need it.

hook: They call him Krev the Skinner. He's killed three of ours this year alone. I've prayed to the old gods for guidance, and they've shown me the path. You are that path. Go to Markarth Depths. Find Krev. End him. End them all.

hook: He killed Gallus. My love. He framed me, stole from the Guild, and laughed while doing it. I've waited twenty-five years for this moment. I can't do it myself—he knows me too well. But you... you can get close. Kill him. For Gallus. For the Guild. For me.

hook: He laughs too much. Talks to the Night Mother. Threatens our Family. I've tried tolerance, but he's a mad dog that needs putting down. Do it quietly. Do it cleanly. The Night Mother will understand. She must.

hook: I've tolerated his presence. His arrogance. His thinly veiled threats. But I've learned the truth—he's here to destroy us from within. I cannot act openly. The Thalmor would use it as pretext for war. But you... you're not bound by such concerns. Make it look like an accident. A magical mishap.

hook: I'm going to speak plainly. Ulfric Stormcloak must die. Not in battle—that would make him a martyr. Quietly. Discreetly. The Empire cannot be seen to have a hand in this. You have no official ties to us. If you succeed, the war ends. If you fail, you were never here.

hook: We're bleeding, and the Empire just keeps coming. We need a victory—a real one. Tullius is the head of the serpent. Cut it off, and the body dies. Get into Solitude. Find the General. Send him to Sovngarde with a Nord's blade in his heart.

description: Ysolda has endured years of Nazeem's condescension, his insults, his constant belittling of her merchant ambitions. She's finally snapped. She wants him dead—not for money, but for satisfaction. She'll pay well for someone to rid Whiterun of his insufferable presence.
hook: Do you know what it's like to be told, every single day, that you'll never amount to anything? That your dreams are worthless? Nazeem has made my life a misery for years. I want him gone. I don't care how. Just... gone.

output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Kill enemies","Name":"A Brother's Betrayal","Giver":"Hemming Black-Briar","Reward":{"Gold Septim":800,"Ale":10},"Favorability":{"Hemming Black-Briar":35,"Sibbi Black-Briar":-50,"Maven Black-Briar":-10},"Actions":["goto Riften Docks","kill Sibbi Black-Briar","goto Riften Docks","report Hemming Black-Briar"]}}
description: Hemming has grown tired of his brother Sibbi's incompetence and the shame he brings to the Black-Briar name. He wants Sibbi eliminated—quietly. Mother would never approve, but Hemming believes it's necessary for the family's future.
hook: My brother is a fool. A liability. He's going to bring the entire family down with his stupidity. Mother coddles him, but I see the truth. He needs to... disappear. Do this for me, and you'll have a powerful friend in Riften.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sven":{"Name":"Sven","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Morthal Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Morthal Swamp","OwnedItems":{"Ale":3,"Bread":2},"Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Faendal","Favorability":-10}]},"Faendal":{"Name":"Faendal","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Morthal Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Morthal Swamp","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Deer Hide":2},"Role":"Ranger","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Sven","Favorability":-10}]}},"Locations":{"Morthal Swamp":{"Name":"Morthal Swamp","Enemies":["Frostbite Spider","Chaurus","Wisp"],"Resources":["Magicka Potion","Health Potion"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Ale":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Ale"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Kill enemies","Name":"The Rival Bard","Giver":"Sven","Reward":{"Gold Septim":200,"Ale":5},"Favorability":{"Sven":30,"Faendal":-50},"Actions":["goto Morthal Swamp","kill Faendal","goto Morthal Swamp","report Sven"]}}
description: Sven is consumed by jealousy over Faendal's relationship with Camilla Valerius. He's convinced that if Faendal were out of the picture, Camilla would finally see him for the romantic hero he believes himself to be. He wants Faendal dead.
hook: She doesn't see him for what he is. A pointy-eared manipulator who's poisoned her mind against me. If he were gone... if he just disappeared... she'd come to her senses. She'd see me. You could make that happen, couldn't you?

input: {"NPCs":{"Tolfdir":{"Name":"Tolfdir","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","OwnedItems":{"Grand Soul Gem":1,"Magicka Potion":8},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Morthal Swamp":{"Name":"Morthal Swamp","Enemies":["Frostbite Spider","Chaurus","Wisp"],"Resources":["Magicka Potion","Health Potion"]},"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Enemies":["Wisp","Hagraven","Troll"],"Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Enemies":{"Wisp":{"Name":"Wisp","Loot":["Grand Soul Gem"]}},"Items":{"Grand Soul Gem":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Grand Soul Gem"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack threatening entities","Name":"The Wandering Wispmother","Giver":"Tolfdir","Reward":{"Grand Soul Gem":3,"Gold Septim":300},"Favorability":{"Tolfdir":15},"Actions":["goto Morthal Swamp","damage Wisp","goto Winterhold Ruins","report Tolfdir"]}}
description: A wispmother has taken up residence in Morthal Swamp, and her wisps are luring travelers to their deaths. Tolfdir wants the creatures dispersed so he can safely study the magical anomalies in the area.
hook: Fascinating creatures, wisps. Tragic, really—the remnants of failed magical experiments or lost souls. The wispmother, however, is considerably more dangerous. Clear the area so I can conduct my research without becoming a cautionary tale.

input: {"NPCs":{"Jarl Balgruuf":{"Name":"Jarl Balgruuf","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":500,"Iron Sword":1,"Bread":3},"Role":"Jarl","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15}]},"Irileth":{"Name":"Irileth","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Jarl Balgruuf","Favorability":35}]}},"Locations":{"Markarth Depths":{"Name":"Markarth Depths","Enemies":["Falmer","Chaurus","Forsworn"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Gold Septim"]},"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Enemies":{"Forsworn":{"Name":"Forsworn","Loot":["Iron Sword","Deer Hide","Health Potion"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Health Potion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Health Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack threatening entities","Name":"The Forsworn Raiders","Giver":"Jarl Balgruuf","Reward":{"Gold Septim":400,"Health Potion":5},"Favorability":{"Jarl Balgruuf":15,"Irileth":10},"Actions":["goto Markarth Depths","damage Forsworn","goto Whiterun Hold","report Jarl Balgruuf"]}}
description: Forsworn raiders have been crossing into Whiterun Hold, attacking outlying farms. Jarl Balgruuf wants them driven back into the Reach before the situation escalates into a full border conflict with Markarth.
hook: The Forsworn grow bold. They test our borders, raid our farms. I will not have my people living in fear. Take the fight to them. Show them that Whiterun is not soft prey.

input: {"NPCs":{"Farengar Secret-Fire":{"Name":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Grand Soul Gem":2,"Magicka Potion":5,"Staff of Frostbite":1},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Solitude Arch":{"Name":"Solitude Arch","Enemies":["Wolf","Vampire","Skeleton"],"Resources":["Corundum Ingot","Silver Ring"]},"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Enemies":{"Vampire":{"Name":"Vampire","Loot":["Black Soul Gem","Health Potion"]}},"Items":{"Black Soul Gem":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Black Soul Gem"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack threatening entities","Name":"The Vampire's Coven","Giver":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Reward":{"Black Soul Gem":2,"Gold Septim":350},"Favorability":{"Farengar Secret-Fire":15},"Actions":["goto Solitude Arch","damage Vampire","goto Whiterun Hold","report Farengar Secret-Fire"]}}
description: Farengar has received reports of a vampire coven establishing itself near Solitude Arch. While he finds the undead academically fascinating, he recognizes the threat they pose. He wants them cleared out—and any black soul gems they possess brought to him for 'study.'
hook: Vampires are a blight, yes, but also an opportunity. Their black soul gems are exceptionally rare and valuable for research. Clear out their little gathering, and bring me any such gems you find. For the safety of the Hold, of course.

input: {"NPCs":{"Urag gro-Shub":{"Name":"Urag gro-Shub","Species":"Orc","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","OwnedItems":{"Staff of Frostbite":1,"Grand Soul Gem":4,"Magicka Potion":10},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Falkreath Graveyard":{"Name":"Falkreath Graveyard","Enemies":["Skeleton","Necromancer","Wolf"],"Resources":["Black Soul Gem","Grand Soul Gem"]},"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Enemies":["Wisp","Hagraven","Troll"],"Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Enemies":{"Necromancer":{"Name":"Necromancer","Loot":["Black Soul Gem","Magicka Potion","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Items":{"Grand Soul Gem":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Grand Soul Gem"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack threatening entities","Name":"The Necromancer's Lair","Giver":"Urag gro-Shub","Reward":{"Grand Soul Gem":2,"Gold Septim":300},"Favorability":{"Urag gro-Shub":15},"Actions":["goto Falkreath Graveyard","damage Necromancer","goto Winterhold Ruins","report Urag gro-Shub"]}}
description: A necromancer has set up shop in Falkreath Graveyard, desecrating tombs and raising the dead. Urag gro-Shub finds this personally offensive—not for moral reasons, but because the necromancer is damaging historical artifacts. He wants the nuisance removed.
hook: I don't care about the corpses. Dig them up, raise them, dance with them for all I care. But this fool is destroying ancient Nord funerary urns that are thousands of years old. Irreplaceable. Put a stop to it. Permanently.

input: {"NPCs":{"Onmund":{"Name":"Onmund","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","OwnedItems":{"Amulet of Mara":1,"Magicka Potion":3},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15}]},"Enthir":{"Name":"Enthir","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","OwnedItems":{"Daedric Artifact Shard":1,"Gold Septim":1000,"Black Soul Gem":2},"Role":"Merchant"}},"Locations":{"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Enemies":["Wisp","Hagraven","Troll"],"Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Magicka Potion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Magicka Potion"},"Amulet of Mara":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Amulet of Mara"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Recover stolen item","Name":"The Stolen Amulet","Giver":"Onmund","Reward":{"Gold Septim":150,"Magicka Potion":3},"Favorability":{"Onmund":20,"Enthir":-10},"Actions":["goto Winterhold Ruins","stealth Enthir","take Amulet of Mara","goto Winterhold Ruins","give Onmund Amulet of Mara"]}}
description: Onmund's Amulet of Mara—a family heirloom—has gone missing. He suspects Enthir, who was admiring it just days before it disappeared. He wants it back but doesn't want to cause a confrontation with the shifty elf.
hook: It was my grandmother's amulet. The only thing I have from home. Enthir was asking about it, admiring it, and now it's gone. I can't prove it was him, and I can't afford to make an enemy of him. Could you... look into it? Quietly?

input: {"NPCs":{"Ulfberth War-Bear":{"Name":"Ulfberth War-Bear","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Bear Pelt":2,"Ale":5},"Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]},"Mikael":{"Name":"Mikael","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Ale":3,"Gold Septim":20},"Role":"Bard"}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Ale":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Ale"},"Silver Ring":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Silver Ring"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Recover stolen item","Name":"The Honningbrew Decanter","Giver":"Ulfberth War-Bear","Reward":{"Gold Septim":200,"Ale":5},"Favorability":{"Ulfberth War-Bear":20,"Mikael":-15},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","stealth Mikael","take Silver Ring","goto Whiterun Hold","give Ulfberth War-Bear Silver Ring"]}}
description: Ulfberth's prized silver decanter—a gift from his father—has been stolen. He's certain that smarmy bard Mikael took it, as the man was eyeing it during his last performance. He wants it back, and he's willing to pay for its return.
hook: That silver decanter was my father's. Meant more to me than gold. That poncy bard was staring at it all night, and now it's gone. I'd confront him myself, but he'd just deny it. Get it back for me. However you need to.

input: {"NPCs":{"Adrianne Avenicci":{"Name":"Adrianne Avenicci","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":3,"Iron Ore":10,"Corundum Ingot":5,"Leather Strips":15},"Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Enemies":{"Bandit":{"Name":"Bandit","Loot":["Iron Sword","Gold Septim","Health Potion"]}},"Items":{"Corundum Ingot":{"Type":"Ingredient","Name":"Corundum Ingot"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Recover stolen item","Name":"The Missing Shipment","Giver":"Adrianne Avenicci","Reward":{"Corundum Ingot":5,"Gold Septim":250},"Favorability":{"Adrianne Avenicci":20,"Bandit":-5},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","goto Bandit","kill Bandit","take Corundum Ingot","goto Whiterun Hold","give Adrianne Avenicci Corundum Ingot"]}}
description: Adrianne's shipment of corundum ingots was stolen by bandits on the road from Dawnstar. She needs those ingots to complete a commission for the Jarl. Recover them, and she'll be eternally grateful—and pay well.
hook: Bandits. On the road from Dawnstar. Took my entire shipment of corundum. The Jarl's new ceremonial sword needs those ingots, and I'm already behind schedule. Get them back for me, and I'll make it worth your while.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sigrid":{"Name":"Sigrid","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","CurrentLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","OwnedItems":{"Bread":3,"Apple Pie":1},"Role":"Farmer","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Dawnstar Quarry":{"Name":"Dawnstar Quarry","Enemies":["Troll","Bandit"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Corundum Ingot"]}},"Enemies":{"Bandit":{"Name":"Bandit","Loot":["Iron Sword","Gold Septim","Health Potion"]}},"Items":{"Bread":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Bread"},"Apple Pie":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Apple Pie"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Silver Ring":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Silver Ring"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Recover stolen item","Name":"A Mother's Desperation","Giver":"Sigrid","Reward":{"Bread":5,"Apple Pie":2,"Gold Septim":100},"Favorability":{"Sigrid":25,"Bandit":-10},"Actions":["goto Dawnstar Quarry","goto Bandit","kill Bandit","take Silver Ring","goto Dawnstar Quarry","give Sigrid Silver Ring"]}}
description: Bandits raided Sigrid's home and took her mother's silver ring—the only valuable thing she owned. She's desperate to get it back, not for its monetary value but for its sentimental worth. Alvor is too old to fight, and she has no one else to turn to.
hook: They came in the night. Took what little we had. My mother's ring... it's all I have left of her. Please, I know it's not worth much, but it's everything to me. Get it back. I'll give you everything I can spare.

input: {"NPCs":{"Proventus Avenicci":{"Name":"Proventus Avenicci","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":250,"Silver Ring":1,"Ale":2},"Role":"Noble","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Bread":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Bread"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Guard entity","Name":"The Jarl's Pantry","Giver":"Proventus Avenicci","Reward":{"Gold Septim":200,"Bread":3},"Favorability":{"Proventus Avenicci":15},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","defend Proventus Avenicci"]}}
description: Proventus is conducting an inventory of the Jarl's winter stores, and he's concerned about theft. With the civil war causing shortages, desperate citizens have been known to raid noble pantries. He needs someone to stand guard while he works.
hook: Winter stores must be counted, but I'd rather not do it alone. Desperate times make desperate people, and the Jarl's pantry is a tempting target. Stand watch. Ensure no one decides to help themselves to the Hold's provisions.

input: {"NPCs":{"Aela the Huntress":{"Name":"Aela the Huntress","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Faction":"The Companions","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Wolf Pelt":3,"Health Potion":2},"Role":"Ranger","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":20}]}},"Factions":{"The Companions":{"Name":"The Companions","DefaultLocation":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Health Potion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Health Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Guard entity","Name":"The Pilgrim's Path","Giver":"The Companions","Reward":{"Gold Septim":250,"Health Potion":3},"Favorability":{"The Companions":10,"Aela the Huntress":15},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","defend Aela the Huntress"]}}
description: Aela is traveling to an ancient hunting ground to perform a ritual to Hircine. The path is dangerous, and she wants someone to watch her back—not because she can't handle herself, but because the ritual requires her full attention.
hook: I hunt alone. Always have. But this ritual... it requires focus. Complete focus. I can't be watching for wolves or bandits while communing with the Huntsman. Watch my back. Interfere only if necessary. This is personal.

input: {"NPCs":{"Brelyna Maryon":{"Name":"Brelyna Maryon","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","OwnedItems":{"Grand Soul Gem":1,"Magicka Potion":5},"Role":"Wizard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Factions":{"The College of Winterhold":{"Name":"The College of Winterhold","DefaultLocation":"Winterhold Ruins"}},"Locations":{"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Enemies":["Wisp","Hagraven","Troll"],"Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Items":{"Magicka Potion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Magicka Potion"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Guard entity","Name":"The Apprentice's Errand","Giver":"The College of Winterhold","Reward":{"Magicka Potion":3,"Gold Septim":100},"Favorability":{"The College of Winterhold":10,"Brelyna Maryon":15},"Actions":["goto Winterhold Ruins","defend Brelyna Maryon"]}}
description: Brelyna Maryon needs to retrieve a rare reagent from a cave near Winterhold, but the cave is known to be inhabited by frostbite spiders. She's a capable mage but easily startled. The College wants someone to accompany her and ensure she returns safely.
hook: It's just a simple reagent retrieval. But there might be spiders. Big ones. I'm not scared—I'm a Telvanni—but it would be... prudent to have backup. Just in case. For efficiency's sake.

input: {"NPCs":{"Irileth":{"Name":"Irileth","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Steel Dagger":1,"Health Potion":2},"Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Factions":{"The Thieves Guild":{"Name":"The Thieves Guild","DefaultLocation":"Riften Docks"}},"Locations":{"Riften Docks":{"Name":"Riften Docks","Enemies":["Skeever","Bandit","Frostbite Spider"],"Resources":["Lockpick","Stamina Potion"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Health Potion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Health Potion"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack enemy","Name":"The Skooma Dealer","Giver":"Irileth","Reward":{"Gold Septim":300,"Health Potion":3},"Favorability":{"Irileth":15,"The Thieves Guild":-10},"Actions":["goto Riften Docks","damage The Thieves Guild"]}}
description: Skooma has been flowing into Whiterun from Riften, and Irileth has traced it back to the Thieves Guild. She wants to send a message by raiding one of their supply caches and destroying their merchandise. A warning to stay out of her Hold.
hook: I don't care what they do in Riften. But they've brought their poison to my streets. There's a cache of skooma in the Docks, guarded by Guild thugs. Destroy it. Send a message. Whiterun is not their playground.

input: {"NPCs":{"Belethor":{"Name":"Belethor","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":1000,"Lockpick":5,"Silver Ring":2,"Deer Hide":3},"Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]},"Ysolda":{"Name":"Ysolda","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":50,"Bread":2,"Apple Pie":1},"Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Silver Ring":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Silver Ring"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack enemy","Name":"The Competing Merchant","Giver":"Belethor","Reward":{"Gold Septim":250,"Silver Ring":1},"Favorability":{"Belethor":15,"Ysolda":-5},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Ysolda"]}}
description: Ysolda has been undercutting Belethor's prices, and he's not happy about it. He wants you to 'discourage' her from continuing this practice—nothing lethal, just enough damage to her stall and goods that she thinks twice about competing with him.
hook: That Khajiit-loving upstart thinks she can waltz into my market and steal my customers? I want her to understand that there are consequences for such... ambition. Break some things. Scare her a little. Nothing permanent, mind you. Just... educational.

input: {"NPCs":{"Carlotta Valentia":{"Name":"Carlotta Valentia","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Bread":4,"Apple Pie":2,"Sweetroll":1},"Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Mikael","Favorability":-20}]},"Mikael":{"Name":"Mikael","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Ale":3,"Gold Septim":20},"Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"Carlotta Valentia","Favorability":-20}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Apple Pie":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Apple Pie"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack enemy","Name":"The Drunken Lout","Giver":"Carlotta Valentia","Reward":{"Apple Pie":2,"Gold Septim":100},"Favorability":{"Carlotta Valentia":15,"Mikael":-10},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Mikael"]}}
description: Mikael has been harassing Carlotta again, showing up drunk at her stall and making inappropriate advances. She wants someone to teach him a lesson—rough him up enough that he thinks twice before bothering her again.
hook: He came by again last night. Drunk. Loud. Scared my daughter. The guards won't do anything—he's just a 'harmless bard.' I want him to understand that I'm not interested. Permanently. A few bruises should get the message across.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sigrid":{"Name":"Sigrid","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","CurrentLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","OwnedItems":{"Bread":3,"Apple Pie":1},"Role":"Farmer","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Alvor","Favorability":30}]},"Alvor":{"Name":"Alvor","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","CurrentLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","OwnedItems":{"Iron Ore":10,"Corundum Ingot":3,"Iron Sword":1},"Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Sigrid","Favorability":30}]}},"Locations":{"Dawnstar Quarry":{"Name":"Dawnstar Quarry","Enemies":["Troll","Bandit"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Corundum Ingot"]}},"Items":{"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"},"Bread":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Bread"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack enemy","Name":"The Unfaithful Husband","Giver":"Sigrid","Reward":{"Gold Septim":150,"Bread":3},"Favorability":{"Sigrid":15,"Alvor":-10},"Actions":["goto Dawnstar Quarry","damage Alvor"]}}
description: Sigrid suspects her husband Alvor has been unfaithful with a woman in Windhelm. She doesn't want him killed—just taught a lesson about loyalty. A few bruises, a black eye, something that will remind him of his vows every time he looks in the mirror.
hook: I've given him everything. Twenty years. And I hear whispers he's been seen with some woman in Windhelm. I can't prove it. But I want him to remember who he's married to. Make it hurt. Not permanent. Just... memorable.

input: {"NPCs":{"Adrianne Avenicci":{"Name":"Adrianne Avenicci","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":3,"Iron Ore":10,"Corundum Ingot":5,"Leather Strips":15},"Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]},"Brenuin":{"Name":"Brenuin","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","OwnedItems":{"Ale":1,"Gold Septim":2},"Role":"Beggar","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Deer Hide","Wolf Pelt"]}},"Items":{"Iron Ore":{"Type":"Ingredient","Name":"Iron Ore"},"Gold Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Gold Septim"}}}
output: {"Quest":{"Structure":"Attack enemy","Name":"The Lazy Apprentice","Giver":"Adrianne Avenicci","Reward":{"Iron Ore":5,"Gold Septim":100},"Favorability":{"Adrianne Avenicci":10,"Brenuin":-5},"Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Brenuin"]}}
description: Adrianne's former apprentice, Brenuin, left her forge to become a beggar, and she's still bitter about the time she wasted training him. She wants someone to rough him up a bit—nothing serious, just enough to remind him what he gave up.
hook: I spent two years teaching that layabout the craft. Two years! And what does he do? Decides begging is easier. Wasted my time and my materials. I want him to remember what real work feels like. A few bruises should jog his memory.

hook: Those blasted mudcrabs are getting bold, Wanderer. They're tearing up the marsh edge! Go to the Whispering Marshes and teach them a lesson—just rough 'em up enough to scare them off. Report back to me when you've sent a few scuttling.

hook: That weasel Gideon Shade! My grandmother's sapphire pendant—gone! He's surely taken it back to his rat's nest in Port Argent. If you could... retrieve it for me, without causing a huge scene, I'd be ever so grateful.

hook: Wanderer, the Council needs a steady hand. We've had reports of Cutthroats planning to torch Hayseed's grain silos. Get out to his farm in Verdantia and stand guard. Make sure no harm comes to him or his stores.

hook: Blackwater's been a damn nuisance, hitting our patrols near The Sinking Ruin. I don't have the men for a full assault. But one capable soul could slip in, give that mercenary a proper thrashing, and slip out. Are you that soul?

hook: Ah, a fellow enthusiast! Look, I need a specific ingredient—a deep-purple Nightshade Petal, the kind Liliana Ravenshadow keeps for herself in that dreadful ruin. I can't very well go knocking. If you could just... borrow a handful for me, I can pay in fire.

hook: You've been... useful. But I'm still not sure where your true loyalties lie. Captain Thorn. He's a problem. A big one. Remove him from the board, permanently, and then we'll talk about trust. Don't come back until it's done.

hook: Careful where you step, dear—spider webs everywhere. They're getting too close for comfort. Could you be a dear and clear out a few of those eight-legged fiends for me? Just enough so I can work without looking over my shoulder.

hook: Blast and botheration! A priceless scroll, gone! I've traced the theft to a Syndicate thief named Nadia Vex. She's probably laying low in the Marshes. Recovering my property is paramount. Discretion is advised; I don't need a guild war.

hook: Aye, we've a delicate matter. Durin's working on something... important. We've caught wind that someone might try to sabotage his forge. Go to Emberpeak and watch over him. No one gets to Durin while he's at his anvil, understood?

hook: See that green-skinned braggart, Korgath Ironskull? He owes me a debt of honor! Go to Emberpeak Forge and give him a few new bruises from me. Tell him Thoric Ironfoot hasn't forgotten.

hook: My grandfather's coin! It was on my nightstand and now it's vanished! That shifty-eyed tiefling, Corvus Umbra—it had to be him. Please, I can't involve the authorities. Just find him and get my coin back. I have a map that might interest you.

hook: A delicate night ahead, friend. Our star performer, Seraphina, is singing for some very important ears. We've caught wind of trouble—someone wants the show to end in disaster. Keep her safe tonight at the Compass, and the Quill will remember it.

hook: That two-faced human trader, Ysabel Valdez! She sold me flawed sapphires! My reputation is on the line. I won't give her the dignity of a lawsuit. Go to Port Argent and teach her a lesson with your fists. A bruised ego is what she deserves.

hook: A little bird told me a certain bookish Council member has a very interesting piece of parchment. A map. I find maps... compelling. He's in Verdantia. Acquire his map for me and bring it to my study in The Sinking Ruin. Quietly, of course.

Helga wants you to infiltrate Port Argent and eliminate Mira permanently, a blow that would cripple the Syndicate's intelligence network.
hook: That silver-tongued snake has blood on her hands. Good Iron Council blood. I've had enough of her games. You go to Port Argent, find Mira Silvertongue, and you end her. Permanently. Bring me word when the deed is done, and you'll have a friend in me for life.

hook: It's them blasted bats! Every night, they swoop down and scare the heifers half to death. I can't get a decent pail of milk! If you could cull a few of 'em on the edge of town, I'd be mighty thankful.

hook: Pirates! Right at our doorstep! They made off with the captain's log from my latest shipment. That book has all my trade secrets. I heard they're holed up at the end of the southern pier. Find that logbook for me, and there's a map in it for you.

The ritual will take a full day and night, during which she will be vulnerable to the swamp's denizens. The Emerald Conclave needs you to stand guard and protect her.
hook: One of our own, Zephyr Nightshade, undertakes a sacred but perilous task in the Whispering Marshes. She cannot be disturbed. We need a steadfast guardian to watch over her until the ritual is complete. The creatures of the marsh will be drawn to the magic. Keep her safe.

hook: That Iron Council lapdog, Serena Wavecrest, is undercutting all my prices! It's unfair. I want you to send her a little message, the kind you deliver with your fists. Just a little... discouragement. Teach her who runs the cloth trade in this port.

hook: Oh, that greedy dwarf in Ironhold! His prices are highway robbery! He's got more silver than he knows what to do with. I just need a little... assistance... to balance the scales. Sneak into his workshop and grab a heavy pouch of crowns for me. I'll bake you fresh honeyed bread for a week!

His prayers have led him to believe the source is Liliana Ravenshadow, a Syndicate wizard dabbling in forces beyond her control. He believes her death is the only way to cleanse the spiritual stain on the land.
hook: A great darkness gathers, child. I feel it in my bones. It stems from the Sinking Ruin, from a woman named Liliana Ravenshadow. She plays with hellfire and damnation. Her soul is lost. You must end her mortal life to save her from an eternity of torment. It is a grim mercy.

hook: Bah! Can't get any decent ore with those walking boulders crashing about! They're just dumb rock, but they pack a wallop. Go down to the quarry and smash a few of them up. Maybe then my apprentices will stop crying and get back to work.

hook: My gown! It's ruined! That snake Corvus Umbra made off with the silver-threaded cloth for my new performance dress. I know he's still here at the inn. Find him, and get it back. A bard's appearance is everything!

hook: That jolly halfling Oswals? He's not as clean as he seems. Word is he's skimming from the Gilded Quill's tax collectors. I want that coin. Sneak into the back of his inn in Verdantia, find his hidden stash, and bring it to me here in the marshes. We'll both be richer for it.

hook: He laughed at my sonnets. Laughed! Percival Quill thinks his words are so sharp? Let's see how sharp they are when he's choking on his own blood. Go to Verdantia. Kill that pompous scholar. I want to hear that the Gilded Quill is writing his obituary.

hook: Sszar has job. Little lights in the marsh. Wisps. Annoying to catch. You go. Smash the lights. Bring Sszar the shiny rocks they leave. Sszar pay.

hook: Someone is trying to spy on our deepest secrets. Kaelen Sunstrider must focus all his energy on renewing the wards of the library. He will be in a trance-like state and utterly defenseless. You must be his shield. Protect him in the Crystalweald Enclave until he awakens.

hook: She cheated! I know she did! That Tilly Tealeaf couldn't bake a pie that good without magic! It's an outrage! Go to her kitchen and... and... just knock her into her own flour bin! Ruin her perfect little dough! It's only fair!

hook: The Iron Council's little merchant, Serena Wavecrest. She thinks she doesn't have to pay for safe passage through our port. She's wrong. I want her to pay up. Get into her office, crack her lockbox, and bring me everything inside. Consider it a lesson in Port Argent economics.

hook: it's personal. He asks you to help him deliver justice—the final kind—to the Syndicate's spymaster.
Structure: She hides in the shadows, pulling strings that have choked the life from those I love. Nyx Shadowmere. Her web of lies has gone unchallenged for too long. I am going to Port Argent, and I am going to end her. I would be honored to have you at my side for this grim task.

hook: We've got a merc, Isolde Frostwind, watching the marsh approach. The last guard vanished. We need you to go out there and stand watch with her. Make sure nothing comes out of that swamp to trouble her—or the Keep. Keep her alive, and you'll be paid.

hook: That thick-headed Boradin! He thinks his water-quench is better than my oil-blend! The nerve! He's in his shop, probably ruining another blade. Go over there and give him a good wallop for me. A bruised ego will cool his temper!

hook: Pssst! Wanderer! A word. I'm working on a little... theatrical project. I need inspiration. That bore Percival Quill has a logbook where he writes down everything. Everything. It's a goldmine of dullness! I need to borrow it for a few days. Could you... acquire it for me? Quietly!

hook: Sweet Mother, sweet Mother, send your child unto me, for the sins of the unworthy must be baptized in blood and fear. I've done the ritual. I've called the Dark Brotherhood. Grelod the Kind must die. She beats us, starves us, and calls it kindness. Please kill her.

description: Gornak the Render, a brutal Orc Bounty Hunter aligned with the Ashen Covenant, has been responsible for the deaths of several Iron Concord patrols in the Shattered Spine. Arin Greycastle has deemed him too great a threat to leave alive and wants you to end his reign of terror.
hook: This isn't just another monster hunt, Aldric. Gornak the Render is a blight, a murderer wearing a bounty hunter's mask. He serves the Ashen Covenant and has the blood of good Concord soldiers on his hands. I need someone I can trust to go to the Shattered Spine and put an end to him, permanently. This is a mission of justice.

hook: Look at the state of these trees! The spiders grow bolder and their webs thicker by the day. They'll sap the life from these ancient groves if we don't act. Please, thin their numbers. The forest will thank you, and so will I.

hook: My voice has lost its joy. A piece of my heart was stolen in that wretched port city—my grandmother's engagement ring. I saw a Tiefling woman, Sera Callisto, slipping through the crowd just as I noticed it was gone. Please, you must find her and get it back. I cannot bear the loss.

hook: That Saltspray woman is a pirate with a fancy title! She's costing me a fortune in lost ore shipments. I can't very well march down to Port Azure and smash her face in with my hammer, much as I'd like to. But you... you could go and teach her a lesson. Make her think twice about messing with the Guild.

hook: My research has hit a wall. I need information that is locked away in one of the Covenant's accursed grimoires. It's held by one of their more... zealous followers, deep within the Citadel. hook: You wish to prove your worth to the Covenant? Words are wind. There is a priestess of the false light in Sunstone Keep, a woman named Seraphina Moonshadow. Her very presence is an affront to our power. Remove her. Do this, and you will have my favor. Fail, and you are nothing to us.

hook: Bah! A perfect moonstone, gone! I'm sure it was that Quickhands brat. He was loitering around my stall all morning. I can't accuse a fellow guild member without proof, but you're an outsider. Find him, and get my gem back. I'll make it worth your while.

hook: She's a clever one, Saltspray. She'll deny everything. But a captain's log... that's a sacred document. It will have all the proof I need. It'll be in her quarters or on her person. description: A powerful Wraith, a soul twisted by the Ashen Covenant's dark magic, now haunts the edges of Shadowfen Swamp. Kaelen Windwalker believes it's the spirit of an ancient ranger, and that putting it to rest will bring peace to the surrounding lands.
hook: The swamp is restless. A wraith of immense power has risen, its sorrow and rage poisoning the land. I sense it was once a guardian of the wilds, corrupted by the Ashen Covenant. I need a warrior to face this spirit and grant it the final peace it deserves. This is a noble task.

hook: The wolves are hungry and they're not picky about what they eat. Carts, caravans, lone travelers—they're all fair game. I'm paying for wolf pelts and a little peace of mind for the folks using the mountain pass. Interested?

hook: Oh dear, oh dear. This is a disaster! A great, green brute of an Orc caught me unawares in the mountains. He made off with my entire payment for a shipment of Nightshade Petals. My supplier will have my head! I can identify the brute. Please, you must get my gold back!

hook: Paperwork is a soldier's nightmare, but it's vital. Stoutheart is carrying documents that the Corsairs would love to get their hands on. He's a scribe, not a fighter. Keep him safe while he's in the city. If anyone tries anything, you know what to do.

hook: These little green pests are a menace. They have no respect for the woods. They set snares that catch deer and start fires to flush out game. I want you to find their camp and give them a reason to pack up and leave. And don't be gentle about it.

hook: Look, I'm a businessman. I deal in opportunities. And right now, there's a massive opportunity sitting in the pocket of a dragon-man named Zan Taloncrest in Port Azure. It's a map. A very special one. I want it. You get it for me, and I'll make sure you're handsomely compensated.

hook: A rat has scurried from my ship into the arms of those Ashen fanatics. He has information that could cripple our operations. I need someone to go to that blasted Citadel, find Niklaus Varne, and make sure his lips are sealed forever. Do this, and you'll have earned my respect and a very large bonus.

hook: Oh, hello dear. I need to get to the lovely Glowcaps in the Hollow, but the path is just covered in the most dreadful, jiggly little slimes. They make such a mess. Would you be a dear and shoo them away for me? I'll pay you for the trouble, of course.

hook: My entire season's work is sitting in some bandit's grubby hands in the mountains! That silk was meant for the finest elven garments this side of the woods. Please, I'm not a fighter. Go and retrieve my cloth, and I'll make you the sharpest tunic you've ever owned.

hook: Those blasted Orcs are sittin' on my iron! I can't get me crew to work with those savages howlin' and throwin' rocks at us. They need to be taught a lesson. Go up there and give 'em a good thrashin'. Break their stuff, send 'em packin'!

hook: She's brilliant, that Bramblewood woman, but so secretive! She's growing Nightshade the likes of which I've never seen. She guards her personal garden jealously. I just need a few petals from her private stock. A small sample, that's all. I'm sure a resourceful person like you could find a way.

hook: This isn't just about culling some beasts. There's a shaman in the mountains who's trying to unite the Orc clans under one banner. A banner soaked in dark magic and pointed right at our gates. I need a proven warrior to go up there and cut the head off this snake before it strikes. This is a mission of utmost importance.

hook: Those screechin' bird-women are drivin' us all mad! They steal our catch and keep us up all night with their infernal racket. The Corsairs won't do nothin' about 'em. Maybe you could go up to the cliffs and clear a few out? I can pay, and the whole docks'll be grateful.

hook: Jory is a fine hunter, but his prey attracts other predators. A large Dire Wolf has been seen in his hunting grounds. He is focused on his task, which leaves him vulnerable. We need you to be his guardian. Keep the wolf away while he does the Circle's work.

hook: That overgrown lizard is flooding the market with rubbish! Swords that'll snap, armor that'll dent if ye sneeze on it. It makes real smiths like me look bad. He needs to learn that his cheap tricks aren't welcome around here. A few bruises should help him remember.

hook: The power in that scroll is different. It's tainted by the same foul energies the Covenant uses. I've sensed it from afar. I need to examine it, to understand the nature of the magic that empowers our enemy. The Shaman will not part with it willingly, of course. Retrieve it for me.

She has deemed Elysia too dangerous to be left alive and asks you to eliminate her.
hook: I have prayed for guidance, and the light has shown me a dark path forward. The wizard Elysia Dawnweaver delves into secrets that could spell doom for us all. She is a flame that must be extinguished before it becomes an inferno. This is not an act of vengeance, but one of terrible necessity. Will you be the instrument of the light's will?

hook: Blasted oozes! They're eating through my tent poles! My research is being dissolved before my eyes. I'm too busy trying to salvage my notes to deal with them. Please, just make them go away! A few well-placed whacks should do it.

hook: I won big, friend! Sold a giant tuna for a sack of gold. But I think that Corsair woman, Nissa, slipped somethin' in me drink. Woke up with a sore head and empty pockets. hook: Stonehelm's a stubborn dwarf, but he's got a nose for good ore. He's found a new vein, but it's in a rough patch of the mountains. He needs to hold his ground for a few days to make the claim legal. Go up there and make sure nobody bothers him while he works.

She covets a specific bolt of rare Silk Cloth that Freya Silverkin in Ironmere has acquired, believing it's wasted on the 'common' designs of the Merchant's Guild. She wants you to liberate it for her.
hook: That woman in Ironmere... she has no vision. She possesses a silk of such exquisite quality, a weave kissed by moonlight, and she will likely turn it into a merchant's tunic or some such drab affair. It is an insult to the craft. I require that silk for a true work of art. Retrieve it for me, and I will ensure you are properly compensated for your... artistic procurement.

hook: A dragon, even a young one, is a threat we cannot ignore. It's burning caravans and eating livestock in the mountains. If we let it grow, it will become a calamity. I need a warrior of renown to go into its lair and slay the beast. This is the kind of deed that songs are written about. Are you up to the task?

hook: The weave of the Giant Spider's silk is unparalleled. It has a strength and shimmer that no mundane silk can match. I require a large quantity for my new collection. While you're out there, dealing with those eight-legged beasts, do be a dear and gather their silk for me. I'll pay well for it.

hook: That old dwarf in Sunstone Keep... Torvin... he taught me everything I know. But when I left to join the Guild, he took my favorite hammer. Said I didn't deserve it. It was a gift from me own father. I want it back. I can't go there meself, it's too painful. But you could slip in and get it for me.

hook: The Nightbreeze woman is our guest, and her voice is a gift. But there are those who would see this gesture of friendship fail. Your duty is simple: stay close to her while she's within our walls. Be her shadow. Anyone who looks at her the wrong way answers to you.

They have deemed her an enemy of the state and have placed a massive bounty on her head. Arin Greycastle, trusting you completely, is offering you the contract to end her reign for good.
hook: This is it, Stormblade. The big one. Saltspray's treachery has gone on long enough. The Concord has officially sanctioned her removal. Permanently. This is a dangerous mission, but you've proven yourself time and again. Go to Port Azure, find the Captain, and bring an end to her piracy. The peace and prosperity of the entire region depend on it.

hook: These beasts are useful guardians, but they lack discipline. They've started seeing anything that moves as prey, including my own soldiers. We need to thin the pack. Go out there and remind them who the true predators are.

hook: I am to be married, my friend. To the most beautiful voice in all the woods. I had the perfect gift made... a moonstone that shines like her eyes. But a mix-up at the shop means it's now in the hands of an apothecary in Ironmere, who's using it to brew potions! I must have it back. Please, I beg you, retrieve my love's wedding gift.

hook: The wolves have been getting bolder lately, friend. Found one sniffing around my back door just last night! If you could deal with a few of them, I'd make it worth your while.

hook: That slippery little rat Silas made off with my best shield! The one with the dwarven steel inlay—took me a week to forge! Get it back for me, and there's a fresh blade in it for you.

Cedric is a nervous man who checks his inventory obsessively, so this will require careful timing. The Syndicate pays well for discretion.
hook: Cedric just got a shipment from the Ebonpeak mines. There's a diamond in that collection that's practically flawless. I want it. You get it for me, and you'll find the Syndicate can be very... appreciative.

Captain Valeria has finally received authorization for a lethal response. She needs someone who won't hesitate to end this threat permanently.
hook: This isn't a job for the faint of heart. Gornak has Legion blood on his hands—good soldiers who had families. I need someone who can find him in that cursed chasm and make sure he never sees the surface again. Are you that someone?

Seraphina has killed three of Vesper's best thieves. The Shadow Syndicate wants her eliminated, and they're willing to pay handsomely to someone with... flexible morals. This will make you enemies with the Iron Legion if discovered.
hook: Seraphina Flameheart. That name means anything to you? She's killed friends of mine. Good friends. I want her head, and I'm willing to pay enough gold to make you rich. But understand this—you take this job, you're choosing a side. No going back.

description: Lysandra the Herbalist needs spider silk for her medicinal poultices, but the giant spiders in Verdant Glade have become unusually aggressive. She can't safely harvest what she needs. Clear out some of the spiders so she can gather her supplies in peace.
hook: Those eight-legged terrors have gotten worse lately. I tried to gather silk yesterday and nearly lost a hand! If you could thin their numbers a bit, I'd be happy to share some of my healing brews with you.

description: Cedric the Jeweler is distraught—a collection of silver rings was stolen during the night. He's certain Caspian the Cunning is responsible, as the thief was spotted in Sunspear Harbor around the time of the theft. Caspian has fled to the Whispering Dunes. Cedric doesn't care how you get the rings back, only that you do.
hook: Those rings were commissioned for a noble's wedding! If I don't get them back, my reputation is ruined! Please, find that thief Caspian and recover my silver. I don't care what you have to do—just bring them home!

The Circle of the Crescent fears that agents of the Shadow Syndicate might use this opportunity to attack him. They need someone to stand guard while Orion completes his work.
hook: Orion attempts to commune with the ancients tonight. The ritual requires his complete focus—he'll be defenseless. We've heard whispers that the Syndicate knows about this. Stand watch over him. If anything threatens the Magister, deal with it.

He wants you to rough up Quinn the Quick, one of their prominent merchants, during his evening walk home. Nothing lethal—just enough to make Quinn nervous and the Guild look weak.
hook: Quinn thinks he's untouchable, walking around the Harbor like he owns the place. I want you to remind him that the Syndicate's reach extends everywhere. Shake him up a bit—take his coin purse if you want—but leave him breathing. This is about sending a message.

Zargoth disagrees vehemently and wants those scrolls. He can't take them himself without causing a rift in the Circle, but you're not a member. He wants you to acquire the scrolls discreetly.
hook: Aldric hoards knowledge like a dragon hoards gold. There are scrolls in his study that I need for my research—scrolls about orcish heritage that are rightfully mine to study. I cannot take them myself, but you... you owe no allegiance to the Circle's petty politics. Bring them to me, and I'll share their secrets.

hook: Can't get a proper day's work done with those eight-legged bastards crawling everywhere! Lost a good pickaxe to their webs yesterday. Clear 'em out of the eastern tunnel, and I'll make sure you get a share of the ore we pull out.

He believes Jax the Jester, that 'insufferable halfling performer' who passed through town last week, is responsible. Jax has been spotted in Sunspear Harbor. Alistair needs that key back before anyone discovers it's missing.
hook: This is rather embarrassing, but my personal key has gone missing. If certain people in town knew, it would undermine confidence in my leadership. I'm certain that jester took it—he was far too interested in my office during his performance. Find him. Get my key back. Quietly.

They're concerned about potential interference from the Shadow Syndicate, who would love to disrupt dwarf-human relations. Guard Grimm during the meeting.
hook: These negotiations are delicate. If something were to happen to Grimm during the talks, it could set back relations with Ironfort for years. Stand guard. Look intimidating. Make sure no 'accidents' occur while we hammer out this agreement.

She wants you to intercept Yara, rough her up, and take the documents. Astrid doesn't want Yara killed—the documents are the real prize, and a dead courier teaches no lessons.
hook: Yara moves messages for the Syndicate. Today she's carrying something important—we don't know what, but Vesper doesn't use his best people for routine deliveries. Find her on the marsh road. Take those documents. Leave her bruised but breathing—I want her to tell Vesper exactly who outmaneuvered him.

description: Delilah Dusk needs troll fat for her alchemical experiments, but trolls are dangerous to hunt. She's heard that Gornak Skullcrusher has been killing trolls in The Underdark Chasm and stockpiling their fat. She wants you to steal some from Gornak's camp. This is dangerous—Gornak is violent and unpredictable—but Delilah's paying well.
hook: Gornak's been hoarding troll fat like it's liquid gold. I need it for my work, and I'd rather not get my skull crushed trying to negotiate with that orc. Sneak into his camp, grab what you can carry, and get out. I'll make it worth the risk.

She's been using Circle knowledge to create poisons for the Syndicate. The Circle has declared her a traitor and authorized her elimination. This is a test of loyalty and discretion.
hook: Nyx was one of us, once. She betrayed our trust, stole our secrets, and now uses them to empower our enemies. The Circle cannot let this stand. Find her in the Marsh. End her threat to our order. Do this, and you will have earned our deepest trust.

hook: The dead don't rest easy in the dunes. Something's stirred them up—wraiths, floating through the night, hungry for the living. I can't hunt properly with those things drifting about. Put a few of them to final rest, and I'll give you a bow worthy of the task.

She's tracked it to Caspian the Cunning, who's fled to the Whispering Dunes. Fiora wants her diamond back, and she doesn't care what happens to the thief.
hook: That diamond was my pride! Three months I spent digging it out, and some smooth-talking thief makes off with it? I want it back. Find Caspian. Take back what's mine. And if he resists... well, the dunes are a fine place to bury someone.

description: Finn the Fisherman has been threatened by someone he owes money to—likely a Syndicate loan shark. He's afraid to go down to the river alone, and the village needs his catch. Elderic wants you to accompany Finn on his fishing trips for a few days, keeping an eye out for trouble.
hook: Poor Finn's scared to go near the water. Owed some silver to the wrong people, I reckon. Can't blame him—those Syndicate types don't make idle threats. Just stand watch while he does his fishing. If anyone shows up looking for payment, convince them to extend his deadline.

Rough up Torvin and destroy his shipment manifest. This will delay their deliveries for weeks and give the Syndicate leverage in negotiations.
hook: The dwarves think they can just dig up the mountains and ship their ore wherever they please, without paying proper 'taxes' to the Syndicate. Torvin's the key to their operation. Pay him a visit. Break a few things. Remind him that the Marsh has long arms.

description: Anya Winterbreeze has been denied membership in the Circle of the Crescent despite her magical talents. She believes this is due to prejudice against her isolation in the Frostfang Mountains. She wants a set of official Circle robes—specifically Elara Moonshadow's—to study their enchantments and, admittedly, to prove she can acquire them.
hook: The Circle looks down on me because I prefer the mountain's solitude to their glade's politics. Elara's robes are imbued with protective enchantments I wish to understand. I don't want to hurt anyone, but I do want those robes. Bring them to me, and I'll share what I learn from them.

hook: Those little green menaces came right up to my fence line! Took half my harvest of mushrooms and scared my farmhands half to death. I can't afford to lose more. Teach those goblins that Willowwood Farm isn't their personal pantry.

He believes Delilah Dusk, a rival alchemist from the Shadow Syndicate, is responsible. He needs that scroll back; it contains the only known formula for a potion he's been developing for years.
hook: That scroll was my life's work! Well, not mine—it's ancient—but the formula! I was so close to replicating it! Delilah must have heard about my progress. Please, find her and get my scroll back. I don't care how you do it. Just bring it home.

The Legion has received intelligence that the Shadow Syndicate might attempt to sabotage his work. They want someone to guard Nix while he completes the final stages of his research.
hook: Nix is close to a breakthrough—something that could change the tide of every skirmish we fight. The Syndicate knows it too. We need eyes on him, day and night, until he's done. Anyone suspicious comes near that workshop, you deal with them.

hook: Found their camp—nestled in a hollow just off the main road. Their leader's a nasty piece of work, calls himself 'The Marauder.' Take him down, and the rest will run like rabbits. Simple work for someone who knows which end of a sword to hold.

hook: Xander! Oh, Xander the Generous, Xander the Welcoming, Xander the... Foolish! The man keeps his gold under his bed. Under his bed! Like a child hiding sweets! It would be almost criminal not to teach him better security practices. Relieve him of some of that burden. We'll split it, and I'll write a very funny song about it.

description: Talia Sunshadow reports that harpies have been nesting too close to the sacred groves of Verdant Glade. Their screeching disturbs the rituals, and they've been known to attack Circle members gathering herbs. She needs someone to thin their numbers and collect feathers for Circle use.
hook: The harpies have grown bold. Yesterday one tried to snatch Selene's ritual chalice right from the altar! We need to remind them that the Glade belongs to the Circle. Bring me feathers as proof of your hunt, and I'll see you're properly rewarded.

description: Isolde the Fair is heartbroken. A silver ring—a family heirloom given to her by her grandmother—was stolen by someone she trusted. She'd been seeing a charming tiefling who passed through Riverwood, but he disappeared one night along with her ring. She's since learned his real name is Revas Vengeance, and he's with the Shadow Syndicate in Stillwater Marsh.
hook: He said he loved my singing. Said I had the voice of a goddess. And all the while, he was just waiting to rob me blind! That ring was my grandmother's—the only thing of hers I have left. Please, find Revas. Get my ring back. I don't want him hurt, I just... I just want my grandmother's ring.

hook: Cedric's getting his quarterly gem shipment today. If the Syndicate were to strike, this would be the moment. Stand with him, look menacing, and make sure every diamond makes it into his strongbox. The Guild takes care of those who protect its interests.

Sten doesn't want to wipe out the whole camp (that would take an army), but crippling their leadership will send a strong message.
hook: Orcs think the mountains belong to them. They've been testing our defenses, seeing how far they can push. Their berserker leader is the driving force—a big brute with more rage than sense. Put him down, and the rest will think twice about raiding Legion territory.

The notes apparently contain information about ancient ruins in the Whispering Dunes. Caspian is passing the job to you—he's too well-known in Ironfort to show his face.
hook: Eamon's been digging into things he shouldn't. Old things. Buried things. My client wants his research, and I want my cut. You're fresh enough that Ironfort won't recognize you. Get into Eamon's study, take his scrolls, and meet me in the Dunes. Simple, clean, profitable.

hook: The dead should remain dead. Something has disturbed them—perhaps grave robbers, perhaps darker forces. I cannot leave my shrine to investigate, but you can. Find these walking bones and grant them the final rest they deserve. It is a mercy, truly.

hook: They have my sister's ring! It's not valuable—just sentimental—but they think I'm a wealthy Guild member who'll pay anything. I can't pay their ransom. I can barely keep my shop running! Please, find this Yara person. Get the ring back. I don't care what you have to do—just bring it home.

Drogan Hammerhand will accompany him as protection, but the Assembly wants additional security. They've heard rumors that someone—likely the Syndicate—wants to disrupt these negotiations.
hook: Roric's got the silver tongue of the Assembly. Drogan's got the hammer arm. But two dwarves, even skilled ones, can be overwhelmed. We need a third set of eyes, someone who can watch for threats while they focus on the negotiations. Keep them safe, and the Assembly will remember.

Vesper wants you to ambush her, take her message satchel, and rough her up enough that she'll think twice about traveling alone. He specifically wants her alive—a dead courier brings too much heat.
hook: Lyra moves between the Glade and the village like a little silver fish. Too trusting, that one. Takes the same path every time. Intercept her. Take her satchel. Make it clear that the roads aren't safe for Circle messengers anymore. But keep her breathing—I want her to tell Orion exactly who's watching.

description: Eamon the Erudite believes that Zargoth the Wise is hoarding magic gems that rightfully belong to the broader scholarly community. He claims Zargoth acquired them through 'aggressive negotiations' with traveling merchants. Eamon wants you to liberate some of these gems so he can study their properties. He justifies this as 'redistributing knowledge.'
hook: Knowledge shouldn't be locked away! Those gems could advance our understanding of enchantment by decades, but Zargoth keeps them in a chest under his bed like a miser. I've tried reasoning with him. I've tried appealing to the Circle. Nothing. So I'm appealing to you. Bring me those gems, and I'll share everything I learn.

description: Seraphina Flameheart has been tracking a pack of dire wolves in the Frostfang Mountains. They're larger and more aggressive than normal wolves, and they've been killing mountain goats that local hunters depend on. She wants help thinning the pack before they turn to hunting people.
hook: Dire wolves. Bigger, smarter, meaner than their smaller cousins. This pack's been devastating the mountain goat population. Hungry wolves are desperate wolves, and desperate wolves attack travelers. Help me thin their numbers, and you can keep whatever pelts you harvest.

description: Ulfgar Thunderfist's ancestral forging hammer was stolen during a raid on a supply caravan. The hammer itself isn't magically special, but it's been in his family for seven generations. He's tracked it to Gornak Skullcrusher in The Underdark Chasm. Ulfgar wants it back—and he wants Gornak to pay for taking it.
hook: That hammer was my grandfather's grandfather's. It's not enchanted. It's not made of rare metals. But every Thunderfist for seven generations has forged their masterwork with it. Gornak took it from me. I want it back, and I want you to make sure he never takes anything from anyone again.

hook: Cora stood up to them. Refused their 'protection' demands. Brave woman, but bravery needs backup. Spend a few nights watching her shop. If anyone shows up looking to teach her a lesson, you teach them one instead.

hook: The dwarves think their mountain makes them safe. Beatrice patrols the lower tunnels every night, same route, same time. Predictable. Show her she's not as safe as she thinks. Take her schedule—I want to know their patrol patterns. Leave her alive, though. I want her telling all her friends how vulnerable they really are.

description: Rosalind the Red needs a specific type of cave mushroom that only grows in the deep mines of Ebonpeak. The Stonelord Assembly tightly controls access to these mushrooms, selling them at prices Rosalind finds 'extortionate.' She wants you to acquire some directly from the source—specifically from Brom the Miner's personal stash.
hook: Those dwarves charge ten times what these mushrooms are worth! They grow in caves! Caves! They're practically weeds down there! Brom keeps a personal collection of the best specimens—he's a miner, not an alchemist, what does he need them for? Relieve him of some. I'll pay fairly, unlike certain mountain-dwelling profiteers.

He can't take it down alone, but he knows the grove would provide months of harvest. He wants help damaging the troll enough to drive it deeper into the chasm—he doesn't need it killed, just convinced to relocate.
hook: There's a mushroom grove down there that would feed a village. But a troll's claimed it as its territory. I've watched it—it's smart enough to avoid fights it can't win. If we hit it hard together, wound it badly, it'll retreat deeper and find new territory. I need those mushrooms. You need coin. Let's help each other.

She believes Silas the Sly, who was 'performing' in the village at the time, is responsible. The chalice has minimal material value but immense spiritual importance to her.
hook: That chalice has blessed every Circle ceremony for three hundred years. It's not worth much as silver—it's thin, ancient, delicate. But to me, to the Circle, it's irreplaceable. Silas took it because he could, because stealing from a priestess amused him. Please, retrieve it. I don't care how—just bring it home to the Glade.

Some of her songs gently mock local figures, including a certain Syndicate member she once knew. The Mayor wants someone to keep an eye on the crowd and ensure nothing disrupts her performance.
hook: Isolde's got a sharp tongue and a beautiful voice. She's also got a habit of singing about people who'd rather not be sung about. I just want the festival to go smoothly—no fights, no 'accidents,' no one dragging her off stage. Stand near the front. Look like you'd be trouble to start trouble with.

hook: The Circle thinks they're so pure, so above the concerns of 'lesser' folk. Let's remind them they need to eat like everyone else. Wren's farm feeds their precious rituals. Visit her. Make it clear that her connection to the Circle makes her a target. Break some things. Leave her scared, not dead—fear spreads faster than corpses.

Sskathiss wants to send a message by stealing Finn's daily catch. He finds the whole concept of 'owning' a river absurd but is willing to play by human rules to make his point.
hook: Finn claims this water is 'his.' Claims his village 'owns' the fish that swim through. The marsh folk know better—water belongs to itself. But Finn won't listen to reason. So we speak his language. Take his catch. Show him that claiming something doesn't make it yours. The fish will taste the same regardless.

The Legion needs that pass clear—it's the fastest route to the northern outposts. Clear out those specters, and I'll make sure you're compensated for facing what most soldiers would run from.

The Syndicate has authorized a lethal response. Darius is currently camped in The Golden Plain, hunting another target. Revas wants him eliminated before he kills more Syndicate operatives.
hook: Darius. That self-righteous Legion dog has been hunting my people like animals. He's killed friends of mine. People I owed debts to. People who owed me debts. The Syndicate wants him dead, and frankly, so do I. Find him in the Golden Plain. End his little crusade. Do this, and you'll have friends in dark places for life. But know this—the Legion won't forgive this. Are you ready to choose sides?

hook: You there, wanderer. The wolves in the Frostfangs have a taste for our venison and our men. Cull a few of the beasts and report back. The Iron Circle remembers its friends.

hook: Blasted Mudcrabs! They've got a taste for my cabbages! Go down to the riverbank and smash a few of them, will you? I'll make it worth your while.

hook: My bow, my beautiful Elven Bow... gone! I'm certain that snake Sven in Riverwood is behind this. He's always been jealous of my talent. Could you retrieve it for me? Discretion is key.

hook: A halfling, Grimm Pickwick, made off with my silver ring down in The Warrens. It was my mother's. I don't care what you do to get it back, just bring it to me. Quietly.

hook: The Legion's brutish scouts have been spotted near the Hollow. Kaelen Sunshadow's work is too important to be interrupted. Stand guard over him while he performs his ritual. Let no harm come to him.

hook: Tempers are flaring in the Keep. We need you to stand guard over Jarl Balgruuf. Keep your eyes open for any trouble and make sure no harm comes to him during these negotiations.

hook: Mercer's gotten too comfortable, too arrogant. I need you to remind him he's not untouchable. Find him in The Warrens and give him a beating he won't soon forget. Don't kill him... not yet.

hook: Those Legion dogs think they can just waltz into our lands? Find their quartermaster, Gorath the Unbroken, near Broken Fang Pass. Crack his thick skull and remind the Legion who they're dealing with.

hook: Belethor's playing a crooked game, and I need proof. His ledger has all his secrets. If you can 'borrow' it from his shop without him knowing, I can put a stop to his scheming. I'll make it worth your while.

hook: A... client of mine is in need of a Giant's Toe. A rare thing. Arcadia in Whispering Hollow has one. I don't care how you get it, but bring it to me. The shadows will reward you.

hook: I have the proof. Mercer Frey sold his soul and ours to the darkness. He's a traitor to the Syndicate and everything it stood for. I need you to end him. For all of us. Do this, and you will have the eternal gratitude of the true Shadowmere Syndicate.

hook: That pointy-eared witch, Elara Evenstar... she's cost me more good warriors than I can count. She thinks she's safe in her precious Whispering Hollow. Prove your worth to the Legion. Bring me her head.

hook: Ah, a capable-looking individual! The crypts below the keep are... stirring. Skeletal Warriors are shambling about. It's making my research quite difficult. Go down there and smash a few of them to dust, would you? I'll reward you with something from my collection.
