hook: By the Eight, my shipment of Moonstone Ore! Gone! That good-for-nothing bard Sven was in here earlier, eyeing it. I'd bet my last Septim he's got it stashed somewhere. Get it back for me and I'll see you properly outfitted.

hook: Farengar is off to bury his nose in books at the Great Library. We have reason to believe the Cabal of Echoes might try to... 'borrow' his research. Permanently. Go with him, keep your eyes sharp, and make sure no one disturbs his studies.

Valerius Decimus wants you to send him a clear message by roughing up his steward, Proventus. It's a warning to the Iron Circle that their walls are not as safe as they think.
hook: The good Steward Avenicci has been making life... difficult for my associates. He needs to be reminded that his position does not make him untouchable. Find him in the Keep and teach him a lesson in humility. A few bruises should suffice.

He wants you to disrupt her work by destroying some of her research notes and... perhaps accidentally singeing her in the process. It will set her back weeks.
hook: J'zargo has a... small problem. Mirabelle thinks she is so much better than J'zargo. She has notes, important notes, in the Great Library. If those notes were to be... damaged, and she was perhaps a little scorched in the process, it would be most beneficial to J'zargo's standing.

hook: Calcelmo has a fascinating tome on conjuration that I simply must examine! He's so possessive of his books, though. Wouldn't let me near it. I don't suppose you could... liberate it from his study in the Library for a short while? Purely for academic purposes, of course.

hook: There is a darkness festering in Riverwood. That raving priest, Heimskr... he hides a Black Soul Gem. Such a thing is too dangerous to be left in the hands of a madman. Retrieve it for me. The Cabal will ensure it is properly contained.

hook: There's an Orc leading the raids from the Pass. A real monster. We've lost too many good soldiers to him. The Circle is putting a major bounty on his head. Bring back his axe as proof, and you'll have earned a place of high honor with us.

hook: Irileth. The Jarl's shadow. She's cut too deep into our operations. She knows too much, sees too much. I have a contract for her life. It's the most dangerous job we have, but the rewards... and our gratitude... would be immense. Are you the one for this?

hook: Listen to that racket! Giant Bats in the storehouse. They're spoiling the good ale and the regulars are starting to talk. Think you could go up there and thin the flock a bit? I'll set you up with a warm meal and a fresh tankard.

hook: The poor souls trapped in the Crimson Mire. Their spirits cannot find peace. They've become Wraiths, luring others to a similar fate. Could you go to the mire's edge and release a few of them from their torment? It would be a great act of mercy.

hook: My daughter's wedding ring... a one-of-a-kind piece I crafted myself. Looted by those Legion dogs. I have it on good authority that a one-eyed brute named Torvar is wearing it like some war trophy. Bring it back to me, and I'll be forever in your debt.

hook: One of my most potent scrolls is missing. I felt a magical disturbance, and I'm certain it was that tiefling, Vivienne Onis. She's a known associate of the Syndicate in The Warrens. Please, retrieve my scroll before she sells it to some nefarious character.

hook: That fool Belethor owes us a lot of coin, and now some thugs from a rival operation want to collect from him first. Permanently. We can't have our investment get killed before he pays us. Keep an eye on him and his shop for a couple of days.

hook: We've had reports of some rough types causing a stir at Gerdur's place in Riverwood. She's a good woman and runs a clean establishment for the Guild. Head over there and keep the peace for the night. Make sure no tables get broken... or skulls.

hook: That gnomish trickster Fizzwick! He's been selling me watered-down ingredients, I'm sure of it! He thinks he can make a fool of the Iron Circle's apothecary. Go to the Great Library and... ruin some of his precious notes and equipment. Let's see how he likes it.

hook: One of the Legion's best hunters is sniffing around our borders. Aela. She's dangerous and she's marking our patrol routes. Find her in the Hollow and give her a reason to limp back to her Legion masters. Do not kill her, just make her regret coming here.

description: Irileth has been trying to root out The Unseen Hand's network in Stonewatch Keep. She knows the old fence, Brynjar, holds a master list of all their agents and contacts. She wants that list. It would be a crippling blow to the Hand's operations.
hook: The old man, Brynjar... he's the key. He's a careful old fox, but I know he keeps a written record of his network. A list of contacts. It would be in his private quarters in The Warrens. Get me that list. It will save the Circle a lot of trouble.

hook: That bow of Lyra's... it's the only reason she's better than me. It must be enchanted! I want it. Get it for me. It's just sitting in her room in Whispering Hollow. No one will even miss it for a while. Bring it to me, and I'll finally be the bard I was meant to be!

hook: My couriers are refusing to go near our drop point at the Sunken Docks. Damn Slaughterfish have moved in and they're more aggressive than usual. Go and clear a few out, would you? The work of the Hand can't be stopped by a few fish.

hook: A stupid Cave Troll has made its lair in one of our tunnels near the Pass. It's too strong for a few scouts, and it's blocking a key route. Go and drive it out. Hurt it bad enough and it'll find a new home. The Legion pays its helpers.

hook: A rather... embarrassing amount of gold has vanished from the treasury. I have reason to believe a Syndicate thief named Nimriel is responsible. She's likely back in The Warrens by now. Retrieve the gold, and I will reward you handsomely. And discreetly.

hook: My hammer! My best hammer. That dwarf, Anska Ironhand, was eyeing it the whole time she was here. I'm certain she took it back with her to Ironfrost Citadel. I want it back. It's not just a tool, it was a gift. Be careful up there.

hook: Faendal is on the move with some valuable supplies. The road between Riverwood and the Hollow has been... fraught with danger lately. Go with him. Make sure he, and our supplies, arrive without incident.

The Legion wants to ensure his safety within the 'enemy's' walls, as they don't trust the Iron Circle to protect one of their own. They want an outside agent to be his shadow.
hook: Hadvar is walking into the wolf's den for us. He's going to Stonewatch Keep to talk to the Jarl. We don't trust the Iron Circle to keep him safe if things go sour. We need you there, watching his back. If anyone tries anything, you make sure he walks out of there.

hook: The priestess in Riverwood plans a grand, light-infused ritual. The Cabal finds this... annoying. Her 'blessings' interfere with our work. Go there, ruin her preparations, and make it clear that her ceremony is... unwelcome. Ensure she is in no condition to perform it for some time.

hook: That simple farmer, Hod, has been sticking his nose where it doesn't belong. He's been telling the Circle about our river routes. We need you to pay him a visit. Rough him up a bit. Make sure he understands the cost of being a snitch.

hook: Everyone watches the Keep's treasury, but the real easy money is in Adrianne Avenicci's back room. She's got a private stash, her 'rainy day fund.' I want it. Sneak into her shop, crack her safe, and bring the gold to me. We'll split the profits... in my favor.

hook: My work requires a Falmer Ear, and there are none to be found... except for the one that lizard S'thas is hoarding at the Tankard. I have no desire to bargain with his sort. Retrieve it for me. Quietly. The knowledge I gain will be your reward.

Seraphina Whitewood of the Cabal of Echoes believes its soul is trapped in a powerful Black Soul Gem, and she wants you to destroy the Wraith and bring her the gem it leaves behind. It's a dangerous task for a proven ally.
hook: Deep in the Crimson Mire, a truly ancient spirit writhes in agony. A Wraith of immense power. Slay it, and bring me the Black Soul Gem that anchors it to this world. It contains a soul that will be... useful to the Cabal. This is a task for someone I can truly trust.

description: Ulfgar Bearpelt has a burning, personal vendetta against Durza gro-Malog, the Jarl of the Stormclaw Legion. He wants his head, plain and simple. This is an act of war and will make you a legend to the Iron Circle, and a sworn enemy to every Orc in the Legion. It's a task for a true champion.
hook: That Orc... that monster Durza. He's raided our lands for the last time. He took friends of mine. I want him dead. Not driven off, not wounded. Dead. You bring me his head and his axe, and you'll be a brother to me and a hero to the Circle. What say you?

hook: The Hand is tired of being crushed in Irileth's iron grip. She is too good. She must be removed. This contract is not for the faint of heart. hook: The dwarves of Ironfrost have found a new vein of Moonstone, I'm sure of it. Their smithing has improved dramatically. That miner, Anska Ironhand, will have a sample of the raw ore. I must have it for my studies. It could lead to a breakthrough in enchanted armor. Get it for me.

hook: My silver amulet... it's gone. Finnan Quickfingers was seen skulking around the keep that night. I know it was him. Please, I cannot leave my duties here. Retrieve it from that thieving halfling in the Undercroft, and I will be forever in your debt.

hook: The moonpetal only blooms under Luna's full gaze, and our dear Yvanna must harvest them at their peak. But the woods grow restless of late. Stand guard over her while she works, and the Circle will remember your service.

hook: Silas Darkmere played me. He took documents that could destroy half our operations. He's back in Skyreach Citadel now, probably preparing to hand them over to the Arcanum. Get them back before it's too late. I'll make sure the Syndicate knows who saved them.

hook: Ah, Varen, a moment of your time. The wolves in the Verdant Hollow have grown bold. They've been stalking the woods, and I fear for the safety of those who travel to my shrine. Could you go and teach those beasts to fear men again?

hook: I'd do it myself, but I'm swamped with ledgers. The Emberstone spiders are a menace, but their silk sells for a pretty crown. Head down there, thin their numbers a bit, and I'll make it worth your while.

hook: A word, friend. These damned pirates are costing me a fortune in 'insurance' and lost goods. The Sentinels are too slow. Go to the docks and knock a few of their heads together. Show them Port Azure isn't their personal coinpurse.

hook: Varen, I have a... delicate problem. My ledger has vanished. I have a strong suspicion a light-fingered halfling named Sera Quickfingers made off with it. I need that ledger back, no questions asked. It's worth a hefty sum to me, and my silence.

hook: One of our circle's most potent amulets has been stolen. It festers in the swamp now, in the grasp of a shadow named Nyx. Its power is not meant for her kind. Retrieve it for us, and you will earn the Circle's deep gratitude.

hook: That rock-licking, claim-jumping son of a kobold, Viktor Blackvein! He stole a whole cart of prime Emberstone Ore from my claim! I can't prove it to the guild, but I know it was him. Get it back for me, and there's a fair share of ingots in it for you.

hook: Wanderer, your blade is needed. We've gotten word of a planned ambush on a Stoutheart caravan. Their gold greases a lot of wheels, including ours. Head to the Crossroads Market and stick close to Fiora Goldleaf. Make sure her and her cargo arrive safe.

description: Willow the Hermit is performing a delicate ritual in the depths of the Whispering Caves to commune with the ancient spirits of the earth. The Circle fears she may be vulnerable to the trolls and other creatures that lurk there. They've asked you to stand guard and ensure she is not disturbed.
hook: Willow seeks an audience with the Stone Whispers. Her mind will be elsewhere, and her body vulnerable. The caves are not safe. Go to her, and be her shield until the ritual is complete. Let nothing break her trance.

hook: Listen, Mortimer is a good man with a nose for barley, but he's no fighter. He's heading out to the old Weatherby farm to secure our next batch of grain. The roads are rough. Go with him, keep the old dwarf safe, and there's a warm meal and some coin waiting for you back here.

Apparently, Jax cheated him in a crooked card game and made off with a significant portion of Percival's pay. He can't leave his post to deal with it, but he'd pay good coin for someone to knock Jax the Rat down a few pegs.
hook: See this? This is a black eye from that little weasel Jax. He cheated me blind and then had his Syndicate pals hold me down while he laughed. I want payback. Find him out in the swamp and give him a proper thrashing. Tell him it's from Rustblade.

hook: The Syndicate thinks they can bleed this city dry. They've got their thugs on every corner in the port district. I need someone to go down there and show them the Sentinels still have teeth. Break a few of their bones, and they might get the message.

hook: Blasted mages! They hoard all the good magical reagents. I need a wisp core—the spark from one of those Arcane Wisps that haunt the old Citadel ruins. They won't sell me one, so I need you to go... decommission one for me. For science, of course!

description: Commander Darius believes a senior Syndicate member, Sera Quickfingers, carries a coded coinpurse that contains the locations of several Syndicate safehouses. He wants you to steal this specific coinpurse and bring it to him so the Sentinels can decipher the code and plan a raid.
hook: The Syndicate operates in the shadows, but they leave a trail of coins. I've learned that the thief Sera Quickfingers carries a special purse with coded marks on the coins inside. It's a map to their safehouses. Steal that purse and bring it to me. Quietly.

Kaelen is rumored to have a private reserve that he brags about constantly but never shares. Hugo wants you to borrow a bottle from Kaelen's personal stash so they can finally judge it for themselves.
hook: That pompous Kaelen is always going on about his 'private reserve' brandy, as if the rest of us are just brewing swill! I want to know what makes it so special. He keeps a few bottles in his office at the Crossroads Market. Think you could sneak in and... liberate one? For a proper tasting, of course.

description: Seraphina Vex has her eye on a particular enchanted ring worn by the wizard Aria Spellweaver. She claims the Conclave misappropriated it from a private collection years ago and wants it back. She's willing to pay well for someone with a light touch to retrieve it from Aria's quarters in Sunstone Citadel.
hook: I'm a collector of fine things, Varen. Aria Spellweaver has a ring on her finger that belongs in a proper collection—mine. That Conclave snob never takes it off, but you might find it on her nightstand while she's meditating. Get it for me. Quietly. And don't get caught.

Commander Darius trusts you enough to act as an executioner. Find the deserter and end his treason permanently.
hook: Varen, we have a matter of utmost gravity. One of our own, a man named Garvin, has turned his cloak. He fled to the Emberstone Mines and now runs with the brigands there. His betrayal is a rot that must be cut out. I trust you to see it done. Do not fail me.

description: Nyx Shadowmere sees you as a useful, deniable asset. She wants to eliminate a major thorn in the Syndicate's side—Thorn Briarwood, a powerful ranger of the Verdant Circle. This is a test of your true loyalty or lack thereof. Killing a prominent Circle member would make you an enemy of the forest, but would grant you immense favor with the Syndicate's dark heart.
hook: The Syndicate has many enemies, but few are as meddlesome as the tree-hugger, Thorn Briarwood. He patrols his precious forest, disrupting our operations. I want his head. Literally. Bring me proof of his death, and you will have proven yourself more useful than half the rats in my employ.

He wants you to prove you're the kind of person who can get things done without questions, by ending Borin's life. This act would make you a pariah in Ironhelm Keep, but earn Viktor's twisted loyalty.
hook: Borin Ironfoot... that smug, self-righteous bastard has ruined my life for the last time. He's the reason I'm stuck in this hole while he plays soldier in his fancy keep. I want him dead. You do this for me, and you'll have more than just my gratitude. You'll have my ore, my gold, and my silence. Just get it done.

The problem is that the lower levels are crawling with Sunstone Skeletons, ancient guardians that make exploration difficult. He wants you to explore the ruins, clear out any skeletons you find, and then report back with whatever you discovered.
hook: The Citadel holds many secrets. I believe there's an archive in the lower halls, sealed for centuries. The problem is the... custodians. Animated skeletons that do not take kindly to visitors. Go, explore the depths, deal with any bony resistance, and then tell me what you find. Your eyes will be my own.

Grommash, respecting strength, wants you to go in and do what he couldn't—completely exterminate the nest of Emberstone Cave Spiders so he can at least salvage some pride and the contract's pay.
hook: Little spiders... too many legs. Too fast. We smash many, but they keep coming. You. You look like you have a good smashing arm. Go into that cursed mine and kill them all. Every last skittering one. I will pay you for the furs on your back if you succeed where I could not.

hook: Blessings upon you, traveler. We're running low on supplies, and the hunters are afraid to go into the forest. A massive, ill-tempered boar has been charging anyone who comes near. If you could deal with this creature, the hunters can safely gather what we need.

hook: I'm in a real bind, Varen. My herb gatherers are too scared to go near the swamp. A bunch of those nasty Mire Crocodiles have moved into the shallows. I don't need you to kill them all, just make some noise, cause a ruckus, and convince them to find a new sunbathing spot.

hook: I find myself pulled in two directions, my friend. I have been tasked with guarding Brother Aldric, but Commander Darius has summoned me back to the Keep immediately. I know you are a capable sort. Would you take my place for the day? Just keep the good Brother safe.

hook: Fascinating, aren't they? Relics of a lost age. There are several automatons in the Caves that I simply must have. However, they are still quite... feisty. I need you to soften them up for me. Bash them around until they slow down, and then I can take over. You'll be well compensated from my collection, of course.

hook: Psst. You. Yeah, you. See that halfling innkeeper? Word is he took a set of beautiful, perfectly balanced picks off a drunk who couldn't pay his tab. I want 'em. They're just sitting there, behind the bar. Get them for me, yeah?

hook: There's a troll in the Whispering Caves, a big, nasty brute. He's made the main passage a death trap. I've been tracking him, but I need someone with a strong arm and a stronger stomach to go in and finish the job. Bring me back a piece of his hide as proof.

hook: That gnome... that copper-headed, ledger-loving little schemer! She's been sabotaging me! I know it! I want you to give her a warning she won't forget. A black eye, a broken stall. Just something to let her know Balthazar Grimes isn't a man to be trifled with.

hook: The dead walk. They stink. They scare the prey. My territory is spoiled. You. You go break them. Smash them back into the mud. Then you tell me it is done, and you may hunt here in peace.

Grizzle wants you to accidentally cause a small cave-in near Rurik's favorite mining spot. Nothing fatal, just enough to scare him and ruin his week.
hook: That bearded blowhard Rurik won't shut up about his stupid ore refinement process! He's been strutting around the mines like he's king of the dwarves. I want to wipe that smug look off his face. Go cause a little... accident near his claim. A few loose rocks. Make him think the mine's unstable. It'll be hilarious!

hook: This is a simple, quiet job, Wanderer. The smith Gregor in Verdant Hollow is doing important work for the Keep. We've heard whispers the Syndicate might want to embarrass us by delaying it. Just go there, keep an eye on his forge, and make sure no 'accidents' happen.

hook: It's more of a nuisance than a true threat, but the skeletons are making it impossible to get any quiet study done. They just clatter and clank around. Could you be a dear and smash a few dozen of them? It would do wonders for the ambiance.

hook: Lad, I've a mind to have the finest rug in all of Ironhelm Keep. There's a bear out in the Ravenwood, a real monster. Twice the size of a normal one. I want its pelt. Kill it, bring me proof, and I'll share my best brandy and a heavy purse of gold with you.

hook: That little gnome tried to bury me alive! I know it was him, snickering behind his oversized goggles. My back still aches! I want his precious experiments smashed to bits. Go to his little workshop corner and have an 'accident' with his beakers. See how he likes it.

hook: There's a sad, angry spirit haunting the Weeping Grove. It wails all night and scares the birds. The younger rangers are too spooked to patrol there. Could you go and... help it move on? A bit of forceful encouragement usually does the trick.

hook: The Syndicate's greed poisons our home. One of their chief poachers, a man named Sylas Vane, has orchestrated the slaughter of our sacred stags. The Circle has met, and the judgment is death. You have proven yourself a friend to the wilds. Will you be our blade in the dark?

hook: SCREEE! SCREEE! All day and night! I can't hear myself think! Those blasted bats! Go up there and kill a bunch of them! Just... make them quieter! I'll give you some ore for the trouble, just get them to SHUT UP!

hook: Quinn says I can't do it. Says my aim isn't true enough. I say I can drop a charging Mountain Bear with one arrow. I need a brave, or foolish, soul to get the bear good and angry and bring it running right under my tree stand. You in?

hook: That insipid do-gooder Ophelia makes a healing salve that's simply... perfect for my needs. She wouldn't sell me a drop if her life depended on it. I need you to acquire a jar for me. Be discreet. Her stall is always crowded, it should be easy for someone with nimble fingers.

hook: Some cowards who couldn't hack it in the Sentinels have turned to banditry right under our noses. They're hiding out in the hills. We don't have the men for a full assault right now, but a capable sort like you could go up there, break a few of their heads, and send 'em running.

hook: Darling, I have a client with very specific, very expensive tastes. Aria Spellweaver has a scroll on advanced illusion weaving that he simply must have. That elf never lets it out of her sight... except when she's in the baths. I trust you can find a way to acquire it for me?

Hugo Barrelbrow, the dwarf in charge tonight, is worried they'll start a fight he can't finish. Rosie asks you to just be present in the tavern and look intimidating to keep the peace.
hook: Varen, love, could you do me a huge favor? A bunch of the Trading Co.'s own enforcers are in the common room, and they've had a few too many. Hugo is on his own tonight, and he's a lover, not a fighter. Just... go sit at the bar. Look menacing. Maybe polish your sword. That'll keep them in line.

hook: Fascinating. The spiders are not a random infestation. They are a hive, controlled by a queen deep within the Emberstone Mines. I require its death. Its corpse is a treasure trove of rare alchemical and artifice components. Do this for me, and I will part with some of my most prized possessions.

hook: Sylas Vane. He's been strutting around the docks like he's Nyx's new favorite. He thinks he's clever. I want you to show him he's not. A broken finger, a black eye. Just something to remind him that I have a longer reach than he thinks.

hook: Bad timing, my friend. The Circle calls, but I promised Yelena I'd guide her out of the Caves. The trolls have been more active lately. Would you mind taking my place? Just get her to the cave entrance, and she can handle herself from there.

hook: It's a disaster, Varen! A disaster! My finest casks, meant for the Lord's wedding, were stolen by that little swamp rat Jax! I can't let the Lord think I'm unreliable. Please, go to the swamp, find my brandy, and bring it back before the wedding! I'll make it worth your while in... well, more brandy!

hook: Look, those clanky automatons in the Caves? They're full of wonderful little gears and perfectly tempered springs! But they're also, you know, homicidal. Could you go break one for me? Just smash it until all the good bits fall out, and then bring me those bits. I'll pay you in ore!

hook: This is the big one, Varen. The old man, Theron himself, has a key. It's old, made of a strange, silvery metal. It opens a door that hasn't been opened in centuries. I want it. I know it's dangerous, but think of the payoff. If you can get me that key, you'll be richer than you've ever been.

hook: The big green-skin. Skullsplitter. He steps on my trails. He scares my prey. He is in my territory near the Market. Go. Hit him. Bite him. Make him remember that Fang was here first.

hook: It's an echo, you see. The forest's sorrow has drifted into the stone. These specters are new here, and they are... unwelcome. They disrupt the cave's natural quiet. Could you drive them back? They are not of this place, and they don't belong.

hook: It's not powerful magic, you see. It's just a song. A song my grandmother sang to me. But it's written on a scroll that's been in my family for generations. A little halfling thief made off with it in Port Azure. Please, I don't care about anything else she has. Just bring me back my song.

hook: The eight-legged filth creeping at the grove's edge have grown bold. Thin their numbers, would you? The Circle's patience for their skittering wears thin.

hook: You look like you can handle yourself. Something's been spooking the sheep near the marsh. Go see if you can't persuade those bog-beasts to keep their distance.

hook: My locket! It's gone. That little weasel Jax was eyeing it. I don't care how you get it back, but bringing it to me would earn my... considerable gratitude.

hook: Those damned walking briar patches are ruining my hunting grounds. Tear a few of them apart for me, would you? Their hides aren't worth the trouble, but I'd be grateful all the same.

hook: Ugh! I heard them squeaking again last night! Filthy things are ruining my best linens. Get down there and clear them out! I'll pay you for the pest control.

hook: An item of mine... went missing at the inn. A locket. That halfling, Finnan, has sticky fingers. Retrieve it. Quietly. And don't go opening it.

hook: Lord Crowley has a taste for the dramatic but not the skills to survive it. He wants to see the old ruins. Ensure he returns to the Market with all his limbs and his coin purse still attached.

hook: The Concord's tin soldiers march like clockwork. I want to know their schedule. Get into the Captain's quarters, find his patrol logs, and bring them to me. Let's see if we can't find a few... gaps in their armor.

hook: It's not enough to swat at the gnats. We need to cut off the head. There's a queen harpy up on those cliffs. Bring me her talons as proof, and the Concord will be in your debt.

hook: Those damn bats! My ears are still ringing! They're all over the new shaft. Get in there and thin 'em out so a dwarf can work in peace!

hook: That relic was meant for my research! That pompous peacock, Ezra, is hoarding it in his dusty shop. I don't care how you do it, but I need that keystone back. It's rightfully mine.

description: There have been reports of attempted theft from the supply depot at Ironhold Keep. Corporal Hayes has asked you to stand guard for a night and ensure no light-fingered individuals make off with the Iron Concord's supplies.
hook: Someone's been sniffing around our storehouses. I need an extra set of eyes tonight. Keep watch, and if anyone tries to lift our goods, you have my permission to discourage them.

description: Tessa Hilltopple holds a grudge against Sister Agatha for shooing her away from the apothecary's garden. She wants you to play a prank on the good Sister by damaging her supply crates at the Shadowfen Outpost.
hook: That old biddy chased me off with a broom! Just 'cause I was looking at her stupid flowers. Give her a scare for me. Go knock over some of her precious herb crates. That'll teach her.

hook: My new song is good, but my drinks are boring! I need a showstopper. That elf lady in the woods, Elara, has some magical sparkle-juice. Swipe a vial for me, would you? I'll name the drink after you!

description: A blight is spreading in the Elderwood Grove, centered around a once-peaceful Dryad who has been twisted into a Corrupted Dryad. Elderon trusts you with the sorrowful task of destroying the corrupted spirit to save the rest of the grove.
hook: A heart of the grove has been poisoned. It spreads its sickness to all it touches. I cannot do what must be done. It was once... a friend. You must end its suffering before it consumes the entire grove.

hook: Travel is bad for business when you're worried about being eaten. There's a wolf pack up in the hills that's gotten too bold. Take a few of them down, and the road will be open for trade again.

hook: Finnan owes me gold. He thinks he can hide in that inn and drink my coin away. Go find him. Make him remember his debt to Gorthak. Bring me what's mine.

description: Lenara Goldenleaf is performing a ritual at the edge of the Elderwood Grove that leaves her vulnerable. Kaelen Swiftarrow is concerned that Crimson Bandits or wild beasts might attack, and he wants you to stand guard over Lenara until the ritual is complete.
hook: Lenara is weaving a protection spell, but her mind will be in the weave, not on this world. I cannot be in two places at once. Stand with her. Ensure nothing from the outside world breaks her concentration.

description: Ragnar Grimfang wants to test the defenses of the Shadowfen Outpost. He's ordered you to launch a hit-and-run attack on the outpost, causing as much damage and chaos as possible before retreating.
hook: Those flame-worshippers think their little outpost is safe. Let's show them it's not. Go cause some trouble. Break some things, rough up a few guards. Let them know the Fang is always watching.

hook: That dwarf Bilrin is sitting on a fortune in ore, I'm sure of it. He keeps his own records separate from the Concord's. Get me his personal ledger. The location of that vein is worth a great deal to the right people.

description: Ezra The Collector has finally located a Stone Golem in the Sunken City of Eldrath that he believes guards a chamber full of priceless artifacts. He wants it destroyed so he can send in his own excavation team.
hook: Magnificent, isn't it? The old texts say a construct guards the way to the inner sanctum. A Stone Golem. I need that obstacle removed. Permanently. Reduce it to rubble so my men can pass.

description: Hilda Barleybrew's grain silo on the edge of Verdant Hollow has become infested with Forest Spiders. She's terrified of the things and will pay good coin for someone to go in and clear them out.
hook: Oh, it's just awful! I went to get barley for the ale and saw a leg... a great, hairy leg! They're all over my silo! Please, get rid of them! I can't even look!

hook: A catastrophe! A Lizardfolk made off with my keystone! It's irreplaceable! It has a very specific chip on the third glyph! You must retrieve it. Please, be careful with it!

hook: Brynja's got a good head for potions but not for fighting. She needs to go poking around the marsh for some gods-forsaken flower. Keep the bog-beasts off her while she picks her petals.

hook: The tree-huggers have a camp on the western edge. Stash of food and arrows. Light it up. Let them go hungry for a few days. It'll make my hunting easier.

hook: She took my lute! My baby! Says I owe her coin, but I paid her back fair and square, with interest! Well, mostly. It's in her shop. I can't play without it. Please, you've got to get it back!

hook: Hmph. Look at that. Mindless, eating everything. They're getting too close to my nightshade. Go splash around in 'em a bit. Break 'em up. And don't track the goo into my hut.

hook: A family heirloom, a sapphire of considerable size and clarity, has found its way into the grubby hands of an Orcish cook in that bandit camp. An affront to my house. Retrieve it for me, and you will be handsomely rewarded.

description: Aelindra Mistweave has sensed a disturbance near the ancient Heart Tree at the center of the Elderwood Grove. She cannot leave her vigil, but she fears something foul may try to corrupt the tree. She asks you to stand guard and defend the tree from any threats.
hook: The tree is... unsettled. I hear whispers of corruption on the wind. I must maintain my concentration. You must be the sword and shield for the grove tonight. Let nothing tainted touch its bark.

hook: That tin-star hick Whitfield thinks he can push me around. Show him what happens to bullies. Just rough him up a little. Enough so he remembers to look the other way next time.

hook: Forget jewels, my friend. The real score is walking around in a tin suit. The Concord's tax man, Hayes. He's got a pouch on him that's practically bursting. Let's redistribute some of that wealth.

hook: Need meat for the pot. Those crabs in the marsh are getting feisty. Go crack some shells. Bring back their claws. Don't need proof, just make there be more dead crabs for me to find later.

hook: Those notes contain sacred rites. In the hands of that fiend Nyx, they will be twisted into something profane. Retrieve them. Cleanse them of her touch by bringing them back to the light.

hook: Milo is a gold mine of talent, but he's as helpless as a kitten. He's got a gig near the Keep, and the road is too dangerous for him alone. See that he arrives in one piece to sing his pretty songs.

hook: I can feel their sickening light from here. A ritual of 'protection'. Pah! Go to their outpost and break their little circle. Spill some ink on their chalk lines, knock over their candles. Let them feel the darkness for a change.

hook: That monster Garruk. I owe him a debt of blood. He's out there in the marsh, thinking he's safe. Prove him wrong. Bring me his weapon, his head... I don't care. Just bring me proof that the Butcher of the Fang is finally dead.

hook: Those blasted wolves have been howling all night and scaring off my best customers! A few less of them in the woods would do us all a favor.

hook: The Frost Wraith haunting Frostpeak Mountain was once a paladin of our order—Sir Garreth the Pure. He fell defending a village from an undead horde and rose again as what he once fought. His soul is trapped, suffering. I've prayed for years for a way to free him. The Dawnfather has shown me that only by destroying his wraith form can his soul find peace. This is not a task I give lightly. Free Sir Garreth, and the Chantry will forever be in your debt.

I want you to go down there and remind him who actually runs this city. Crack a few of his ribs if you have to, but don't kill him—I don't need a war with the Blades. Yet.

Morgana possesses a worn spellbook containing a rare alchemical formula for a potent healing salve that Hemlock desperately wants. He asks The Wayfarer to liberate the book from Morgana's quarters in the Grand Archive and bring it to his shack in Shadowfen Swamp.
hook: Morgana Hex has a spellbook—battered old thing, brown leather cover—with a formula I've been trying to recreate for years. She keeps it locked away in her study at the Grand Archive, the paranoid witch. I can't set foot in that place without the Consortium breathing down my neck, but you... you could slip in and out like a shadow. Bring me that book, and I'll teach you a few things about real alchemy.

The Syndicate has decided that the cultist must be permanently removed. This is no mere scouting mission—Elderon Gray needs someone willing to venture into the heart of the Sunken Collective's territory and end the cultist's threat forever.
hook: The Wayfarer, the Syndicate has discussed your contributions, and we believe you're ready for something more... permanent. There's a Cultist of Azar who leads raids into our woods. We know where he performs his rituals. We need you to go to the Sunken City, find him, and make sure he never leads another raid. This isn't a warning—it's an ending. Are you prepared for that?

hook: Please, you look like someone who can handle themselves! Those damned Boglings have been coming up from the swamp every night, snatching my pigs. I chased one off with a pitchfork yesterday, but it'll be back. Just scare them off good and proper, and I'll share what I've got.

Mira wants at least one bottle recovered—partly for the principle, partly because she needs to confirm her suspicions before taking further action.
hook: A whole crate of wine from Dornish vineyards, gone! I know it was Roderick—that rat-faced little weasel was sniffing around my stall all morning. He fences for the Blades down at the docks. I need proof, and I need at least one of those bottles back. They're worth more than you make in a month.

The Wayfarer is to escort her and protect her from any Cultists who might try to silence her.
hook: Sister Althea's made some enemies with her preaching against the Sunken Collective's practices. She's a good woman, and we won't let those fanatics intimidate her. Escort her to the Gilded Tankard and make sure no harm comes to her. The Council protects its own.

She wants The Wayfarer to 'send a message' by roughing up Tinker Wizzlebang—nothing that would get the Iron Council involved, just enough to make him think twice about crossing her.
hook: That insufferable gnome Tinker Wizzlebang has been undermining me for the last time. I can't move against him openly—Consortium politics are a viper's nest—but an outsider like you could teach him a lesson about respecting his betters. A few bruises, nothing permanent. Just make him understand that Madam Zora is not to be trifled with.

hook: The Verdant Syndicate has the most potent nightshade I've ever seen, but that elf Fae Willowisp won't sell to anyone outside her little forest club. I just need a few petals for my research—surely you could slip into her camp and liberate a small sample? She keeps them in a leather pouch by her bedroll. I'd be ever so grateful.

She believes the only way to stop it is to eliminate the shaman before the next full moon. This is no small task—Mok'Rath is well-protected in the Sunken City.
hook: I've prayed on this, and I believe the Divine has sent you to me. Shaman Mok'Rath plans to curse our lands—the farms, the livestock, everything. I've seen it in visions. He must be stopped before the full moon. I know what I'm asking. I know it's terrible. But sometimes the light requires us to walk in shadow. Will you do this terrible, necessary thing?

hook: There's a big cat up here—a Sabrecat with fangs like daggers. It's been watching the pass for days, and I can't get my pelts down to market with it lurking. I don't need it dead, just chased off far enough that I can make my deliveries. You look handy with that weapon. Care to earn some coin and a warm pelt?

She's identified the thief as Nimble Nessa, a halfling pickpocket working for the Obsidian Blades. Holt wants the medallion back, but she doesn't want to start a faction war over a personal matter.
hook: This stays between us. That damned halfling Nimble Nessa lifted my family medallion during the chaos at the docks last week. It's worth nothing to her—just silver—but it was my mother's. I can't send guards after her without it looking like Council aggression against the Blades. But you... you could get it back quietly. I'd be in your debt.

hook: Alara Evenwind insists on examining some pre-Sunken carvings near Azar, and the Consortium has agreed to fund her expedition. We're not sending her alone into that snake pit, though. Escort her, keep her safe while she does her scholarly work, and make sure she returns with her findings—and all her limbs—intact.

The Obsidian Blades don't forget slights, and Uzgra wants The Wayfarer to teach the dwarf a lesson about respecting his business partners. A beating should suffice.
hook: That bearded rat Borin Ironfoot sold me slag and called it good ore. Cost me good coin and made me look weak in front of Krag. I want you to go to the Stonehearth Mines, find him, and break a few of his fingers. Nothing that'll kill him—I want him to remember every time he tries to cheat someone again.

hook: The Consortium has a scroll—old, pre-dating the founding of Ironhaven—that maps ley line convergences throughout the Whispering Woods. With that knowledge, we could establish watch posts that would make our territory impenetrable. The scroll is with a scribe named Lysandra Vex. Get it for us, and you'll have the Syndicate's gratitude—and a much lighter purse.

hook: This isn't a request—it's a contract. A brigand leader has been slaughtering our caravan guards and making off with Council supplies. We've lost twelve good soldiers to this butcher. Commander Thorne wants him dead, and he's authorized substantial payment for the one who brings back his head. Are you the one to collect?

hook: My amethyst! Three months of work, polishing that stone to perfection, and some dockside rat named Jax steals it! I don't care what you have to do—buy it, steal it back, or pry it from his cold dead fingers. Just get me my gem back, and I'll make it worth your while.

hook: Fae Willowisp is going to Market Square to deliver supplies to that gnome alchemist. She knows the woods, but the city is a different kind of dangerous. Meet her at the forest's edge, escort her to Glimmer's shop, and make sure no Market Thugs or pickpockets give her trouble. The Syndicate appreciates those who protect our own.

hook: Varik the Swift carries what looks like a spellbook—worn brown leather, nothing special to look at. It's actually a coded journal of Blades operations. Get me that book without killing anyone or starting a faction war, and the Council will be very generous. Varik usually stays near the docks. Find him, lift the book, and bring it to me.

hook: Ssskareth thinks you are weak. An outsider not worthy of our time. I think differently. Prove me right. High in the Frostfang Peaks, a Glacial Wraith torments the mountain spirits. Destroy it. Bring me proof of its end. Do this, and perhaps the Collective will see you as more than prey.

hook: My miners are useless right now—some great burrowing beast has them all terrified. They call it a Stonehearth Tunneler. I don't need it dead, just convinced to dig elsewhere. My operations are losing gold every day those tunnels are closed. Deal with it, and I'll ensure you're properly compensated.

hook: It's just a handkerchief, I know, but it was given to me by someone special. Some grubby-fingered pickpocket snatched it right from my sleeve while I was performing in the Square! I spotted him—scruffy looking, shifty eyes—he works near Mira's stall. Please, get it back for me. I'll sing songs of your heroism!

hook: Lady Cordelia is conducting research at the Grand Archive. The Consortium tolerates her presence, but there are elements there who would love to see a Vance humiliated. Escort her, ensure she's treated with proper respect, and deal with any... unpleasantness that might arise. Discreetly.

He wants The Wayfarer to rough up the lord—nothing fatal, just enough bruises to remind him that his title doesn't make him untouchable.
hook: That pompous arse Lord Vance had me whipped! In public! Like a common criminal! Well, I may not be able to touch him, but you could. Jump him in an alley, give him a few good cracks, and leave him wondering who he pissed off. I'll pay well for the satisfaction.

The orc just wanted the rod, and Sylas is too scared to confront him. He asks The Wayfarer to steal it back from Krag's quarters at the Ravenport Docks.
hook: That big orc Krag took my grandfather's fishing rod. Said I owed him for docking, but I paid my fees to the Council fair and square! He just wanted the rod—it's got ivory inlays, been in my family for generations. I can't fight him, but maybe you could... get it back? He keeps it in his room above the warehouse by the docks.

description: The Sunken Collective has identified Captain Valeria Holt as a major obstacle to their expansion. She's been coordinating Iron Council patrols that have disrupted Collective operations near the Shadowfen Swamp. Ysara Tidecaller offers this contract to prove The Wayfarer's complete commitment to the Collective's cause.
hook: You have shown promise, Wayfarer. But promise is not loyalty. The Iron Council's Captain Holt harasses our people, kills our scouts, blocks our paths. Remove her. Permanently. Do this, and the Sunken Collective will embrace you as one of our own. Fail, and we will know you were never worthy of our attention.

They're harmless to people but have been damaging scrolls and books with their ethereal presence. Orin the Bookkeeper needs someone to disperse them before irreplaceable knowledge is lost.
hook: Wisps! In the vaults! They're attracted to the magical resonance of our oldest texts, and their mere presence causes the ink to fade. I need someone to go down there and scatter them—a good sword or a blast of magic usually does the trick. Please, some of these scrolls are the only copies in existence!

hook: My cogs! My beautiful, perfectly calibrated cogs! Some Market Square brute stole my entire case and has been selling them off piece by piece for copper scrap! Do you know how long it takes to machine those to my specifications? Get them back, and I don't care what you do to the thief. I just want my cogs!

description: Wesley the Wainwright needs to travel to the Stonehearth Mines to select timber for new wagon construction, but the route has become dangerous with Stonehearth Tunnelers and Highway Brigands active in the area. The Iron Council wants him protected—his wagons are essential for their supply lines.
hook: Wesley makes our wagons. Without wagons, we don't move ore, supplies, or troops. He needs to inspect timber at the Stonehearth Mines, but the route isn't safe. Escort him there, keep him alive while he does his work, and bring him back in one piece. The Council takes care of its essential workers.

He wants The Wayfarer to rough up the fletcher—nothing permanent, but enough to make her think twice about supplying the Syndicate's operations.
hook: The Syndicate's rangers are too well-supplied. Every time we try to move goods through the woods, they're there with fresh arrows and full quivers. That's Isolde's work. She's their fletcher. Give her a beating—break a few fingers if you have to—and maybe she'll reconsider her choice of clients. The Blades pay for results.

description: Brother Theron seeks a polished amethyst that was stolen from his temple and is now in the possession of Yorick the Gravekeeper, a Sunken Collective priest who uses it in his dark ceremonies. Theron believes the gem has sacred properties and wants it returned to its rightful place.
hook: The Sunken Collective stole a sacred amethyst from our temple years ago. I've learned it's now held by a gravekeeper named Yorick in the Sunken City. He uses it in their profane rituals. I cannot ask you to kill, but I can ask you to retrieve what was taken from us. Bring back the amethyst, and you'll have my blessing and my gratitude.

hook: Catastrophic failure! One of my creations—an automaton designed to organize scrolls—has gone completely rogue. It's locked itself in sub-basement three and has been replicating! The Consortium is furious. I need someone to go down there and smash it to pieces before it breaches the main vaults. I'll pay well, and I'll owe you a considerable favor.

hook: Damned Boglings! They can smell my potions from a mile away, and they've been scratching at my door all week. I can't work like this! Go out there and give them a good thrashing—nothing fatal, mind you, just enough to teach them my shack isn't a feeding ground. I'll share some of my healing salves for the trouble.

description: Gwendolyn Reed's recipe book—containing generations of family cooking secrets—was stolen by a Gilded Swindler posing as a wealthy patron at the Gilded Tankard Inn. The swindler has been spotted still staying at the inn, apparently waiting for another mark. Gwendolyn wants her book back.
hook: That silver-tongued devil! He came in dressed like a lord, complimented my cooking, asked to see my recipes—and then walked off with my grandmother's recipe book! He's still at the inn, bold as brass, probably looking for his next victim. Get my book back, and I'll cook you meals fit for a king for a month!

description: A new vein of high-quality iron ore has been discovered deep in the Stonehearth Mines, but the area is infested with Stonehearth Tunnelers. Torvin Coalbeard is leading a crew to extract the ore, and the Iron Council wants them protected during the operation.
hook: Torvin's found a rich vein, but it's in Tunneler territory. We need that ore, but we also need our miners alive. Go down there, watch Torvin's back, and make sure nothing burrows up through the floor and eats anyone. The Council will compensate you for the danger.

Sskareth of the Marsh wants the priest silenced—not killed, but beaten badly enough that he thinks twice before speaking against the Collective again.
hook: The soft-skin priest speaks poison about my people. Calls us monsters, beasts, savages. He stands in his market square and turns your kind against us. I want him to stop. Break his bones. Make him fear to speak our name. Do this, and I will share the swamp's secrets with you.

description: Hargrim Battlehammer wants a supply of the Verdant Syndicate's distinctive obsidian arrowheads—partly for their quality, partly to study them for tactical advantage. Isolde the Fletcher keeps a large stock at her workshop in Whispering Woods. Hargrim wants The Wayfarer to liberate a bundle of them.
hook: Those Syndicate rangers use obsidian arrowheads—nasty things, sharper than steel and they don't rust. I want a bundle of them. Not just for my own use, but to see how they're made. The elf Fletcher keeps them in her workshop. Slip in, grab a bundle, and bring them to me. I'll make it worth your while.

The creature was once a guardian spirit, but something—perhaps the Sunken Collective's influence—has twisted it into a malevolent force. She asks The Wayfarer to end its suffering and cleanse the grove.

I've tried to heal it, but the corruption runs too deep. It must be destroyed so the grove can heal. Will you do this merciful, terrible thing?

They're not dangerous if you're careful, but they make research impossible and they've been known to... pop... if disturbed too roughly. I need someone to go up there and gently dissipate them. A controlled magical discharge usually does the trick.

hook: That little gnome Glimmer has been selling watered-down potions and calling himself an alchemist. It's embarrassing to the profession. I want you to pay him a visit—rough him up a bit, break some of his equipment. Nothing that'll kill him; I just want his customers to see that his shop isn't... safe. Quality alchemy requires a certain atmosphere.

He's been responsible for the deaths of several Syndicate operatives and represents the Blades' most aggressive element. Elderon Gray offers this as a final test of The Wayfarer's loyalty—and as a service that would make the Wayfarer a legend within the Syndicate.
hook: You've proven yourself capable, Wayfarer. Resourceful, deadly when needed, loyal to those who've earned it. But there's one more thing the Syndicate needs. Krag the Unyielding. He's killed our people, tortured our spies, and he's the Blades' iron fist. Remove that fist, and you'll have earned a place among us that no one can question. This is the big one. Are you ready to become a legend in the Whispering Woods?

hook: That snake Cassian Vane slithered through my home and took my grandmother's amulet. I can't accuse him openly without proof or starting a war with the Syndicate. Bring it back to me, and do it quietly. There's a generous reward in it for you.

hook: That Orc brute Gorlag thinks he can squeeze our merchants because his little hideout is in that swamp. I need you to go to The Shadowfen and teach him a lesson in Ironmarch hospitality. Break a few bones.

hook: Nyx Shadowmere has sticky fingers and a vault full of our history. I don't care how you get into The Shadowfen, but I need that tome back. It contains knowledge too dangerous to be in the hands of a common thief.

hook: Elderwyn speaks highly of you, Adventurer. Nyx Shadowmere's hands are stained with the blood of our kin. We do not take this decision lightly, but the shadow must be lifted. Find her in The Shadowfen and ensure she never threatens the Hollow again. Report back to Elderwyn when it is done.

hook: Bah! I can't hear meself think over these winged rats! Go clear 'em out of the south tunnel so we can get back to work. Watch yer head.

hook: It was Tamsin Quickstep! I know it was! My Sweetrolls! She's probably hiding in the docks right now with a belly full of my hard work. Get them back before they're all eaten! I'll share a few with you if you hurry!

hook: Yavanna is too valuable to lose to the woods' dangers. Accompany her on her gathering trip. Ensure no beast or lurking shadow lays a claw on her. The safety of our people relies on her medicines.

hook: That lizard, Ssketh, has been a thorn in my side. He's scaring off our clients in the Cove. I need you to give him a few bruises. Maybe he'll learn to mind his own business if he can't hold a bow steady for a week.

hook: Roric won't even notice a few bars missing from his big pile. The Dwarves are so busy hammering they wouldn't hear a Giant walk by. Sneak into the Keep's smithy and grab me some of that good ore. I'll make it worth the climb.

hook: This mindless brute is costing me gold. I need to know if you're just a common pickpocket or someone who can handle real violence. Go to the Gilded Plain, put that Ogre down, and come back with its tusk. Then we'll talk about real jobs.

hook: I can't get a decent night's sleep with those winged harridans shrieking at the moon. Farmer Lilia is about to lose her goats from fright. Head up to the ridge and thin out their numbers a bit.

hook: That bookish fool Orin Deepdelver! He wouldn't know a real cog if it bit him in the beard, but he knows enough to steal mine! He's holed up in the Citadel with my life's work. Get those cogs back, lad, and don't let him see you.

hook: Lyra's voice is a weapon of diplomacy. Ensure she arrives at the Expanse estates with her lute intact and her throat un-slit. The roads are dangerous, and her safety is paramount to our relations with the outlying lords.

hook: Corbin Fleetwood is too comfortable. He thinks the Syndicate is just a rumor. Go down to the docks and remind him that the Shadowfen's reach is long. I don't need him dead, just... discouraged. Make sure his crew sees it.

hook: Opal hoards knowledge like a dragon hoards gold. But that tome contains secrets that could save lives here in the Hollow. I don't like asking this, but could you... borrow it? Just for a few nights, so I can copy the relevant pages. Opal will never miss it.

hook: There is a malignancy in the swamp, a spirit of pure rage and sorrow. It screams in the Weave, a sound that chills my blood. I need someone I can rely on to go into that mire, find the Restless Spirit, and end its suffering. Permanently. Report back to me with a fragment of its essence.

hook: Look at this! My best net, ruined! The cove is lousy with Mudcrabs today. I can't even wade in to cast a line. Clear a few off the beach for me, will ya? I'll share my lunch.

hook: That little green rat took my rent money! I saw him scamper off toward the plain. Please, you have to get it back! He's probably hiding in a hole somewhere. Be careful, but get my silver back!

hook: We've got a Dwarf with more brains than brawn poking around the deep tunnels. The Conclave is paying good coin for his safety. Go down there and make sure nothing crushes him or eats him. Stand guard while he takes his notes.

hook: I hunt beasts, not men. But these bandits are worse than any wolf I've tracked. They're preying on the weak. Go to their camp near the Keep and give them a taste of their own medicine. Drive them off the road.

hook: Thrain thinks he's so tough behind his big stone walls. Let's see how tough he is without his favorite hammer. Get into the Keep, find his forge, and take that hammer. Bring it to me. I want to see the look on his face when he realizes it's gone.

hook: This fool plays with forces he does not understand. He is drawing power from the old stones in the Woods. If he finishes his ritual, the Shadow Imps will be the least of our worries. I trust you to silence him before he opens a door we cannot close.

hook: That imp is a test of my patience, and I'm afraid I'm failing. It stole the golden candlestick and keeps dropping acorns on my head while I pray. Please, drive it out of the chapel so I can have some peace.

hook: That blade was my father's. I'll not let some Syndicate cutpurse pawn it for a handful of copper. The thief is hiding out on the plain. Retrieve my sword, and do it quietly. I want it back, not a war with the Shadowmere.

hook: Borin will be out in the open directing the lift. His eyes will be on the ropes, not the shadows. You watch the shadows. Anything that tries to get close, you put it down. That ore needs to get inside the Keep walls.

hook: This Elf woman hunts my game, walks my paths. She does not respect the swamp, nor my claim. Go to the Woods. Find her. Hurt her enough that she remembers to stay near her precious Hollow.

hook: The Mayor thinks her vault is secure. Prove her wrong. Bring me the purse with the black raven stamp. Don't get caught. If you do, the Syndicate never heard of you.

hook: Of all the days for a containment ward to fail! That ice construct is freezing centuries of research solid. I need you to go down there and shatter it. Bring me its core gem as proof that the crisis is contained.

hook: Ugh. It smells worse than usual in the south tunnel. Some Lurkers have moved in. They're not exactly dangerous to me, but they are disgusting. Go clear them out. I'm not wading through that muck.

hook: I swear I paid him! But Zephyr is saying the coin was light. I know he just pocketed the extra. Please, I can't pay twice. Can you find him in The Shadowfen and get my silver back? He's too quick for me.

hook: Finnian is a little too trusting for this part of the docks. He'll be flashing gems that are worth more than some sailors make in a year. Just stand there and look like you'd break someone's arm if they touched the merchandise.

hook: That Orc thinks he's clever. He's laughing at us. I want you to wipe the smile off his face. Go to that stinking swamp he calls home and give him a black eye from me. Tell him it's for the ore, the cogs, and the hammer.

hook: Jasper plays the fool, but his cart is full of secrets. He has a book with a blue cover—it's his codex. I need it. The Syndicate wants to know who he's really working for. Lift it from his shop in Port Serenity while he's at the tavern.

hook: The venom from these serpents can fell an ox in minutes. We cannot let them establish a hunting ground so close to our children. Go into the fen, find the largest of the Vipers, and cut off its head. Bring me its venom sacs as proof.

hook: Blasted skeletons! They're not a real threat to the Keep, but they're ugly and they rattle all night. Go down there and break a few skulls. It'll be good practice.

hook: That silent Tiefling took something far more dangerous than gold. He has a key that opens more than just my door. I need it back in my hands tonight. He's likely in The Shadowfen. Retrieve it, and I will reward you with something far more valuable than coin.

hook: Yavanna carries a heavy purse for this transaction. The docks of Port Serenity are full of eyes that will notice it. Stay close to her. Don't let anyone distract you or her. Get her to the ship and back to the Hollow safely.

hook: I want the Covenant to feel unsafe even in their own homes. That Captain, Rowan, he's all smiles about his wedding. Give him a reason to frown. A broken nose at the altar sends a message: 'We can reach you anywhere.'

hook: That lizard Theron thinks he's better than an Orc because he has scales and a fancy ring. I want that ring. I don't care about the magic. I just want to see him lose face when he can't find it. Get it for me.

hook: That thing was a Dwarf once. Now it's just hunger and claws. It's in the dark, and it's fast. I need someone who won't panic down there. Go into the deep tunnels, find the Ghoul, and destroy it. Bring back its head if you can stomach it.

hook: They're not an army, just a few brutes, but I'm a farmer, not a fighter. They took my best milking goat last night! Please, chase them off my land before I lose the whole herd.

hook: Those amulets were a custom order! I'll be ruined if I can't deliver. That little rat Zephyr took them, I just know it. He's probably back in The Shadowfen by now. Get them back for me, quietly. I don't want the whole port to know I was robbed.

hook: That horse is worth more than the wagon it's pulling. Renard is a good merchant, but he's no rider. If they try to take the horse, he'll just hand it over. Make sure he doesn't have to. Guard him until he reaches the buyer's ranch.

hook: That little Halfling talks too much. He's been telling everyone in the Hollow about 'shady characters' he saw. He's hurting business. Go remind him that loose lips can get you a broken jaw.

hook: Quill is a hack! He stole my theories on gem resonance. His new manuscript is in his study. I need to see it to confirm my suspicions. Retrieve it for me. This is purely for academic integrity, of course.

hook: The old tales said the golems would sleep forever. They lied. This one is smashing through load-bearing pillars! I trust you with this, Adventurer. Go down there, break it apart, and bring me a handful of its Dwarven Cogs as proof.

description: Eryn Amberleaf has been tracking a large herd of deer in the Whispering Woods, but a flock of Harpy Screechers has moved into the valley and is scaring all the game away. She needs you to thin their numbers so the ecosystem can return to normal.
hook: Their shrieking is driving every creature with ears out of this part of the forest. I can't hunt if there's nothing to hunt. Go up to the cliffs and quiet them down a bit.

hook: There's a leak in the Keep. Someone is feeding Cassian Vane our troop movements. I need that snake's ledger to root out the traitor in our midst. Find him in Port Serenity and get that book. Do this for me, and you'll have the Legion's deepest gratitude.

description: Eldon Bramblefoot, the innkeeper at the Grumpy Gruff Inn, is worried about a Gloomfang Wolf prowling the edge of the Murkwood Thicket. The beast has been scaring off travelers and delaying shipments of fresh ingredients. He wants you to head into the Thicket, give the wolf a good thrashing to drive it away, and then return to the inn to let him know the route is safe again.
hook: Aye, you look like you can handle yourself. There's a mangy Gloomfang Wolf lurking just off the path to the Murkwood. Scared off poor Peregrin's flour delivery yesterday! Go rough it up a bit, would ya? Make sure it thinks twice before coming back, and then swing by to tell me the deed's done.

Her prized Shimmering Sapphire locket, an heirloom, was lifted by a nimble-fingered thief named Tamsin Quickstep who has since fled to the bustling Shifting Sands Bazaar. Elara wants you to travel to the Bazaar, use your stealth to retrieve the locket from Tamsin without causing a scene, and bring it back to her at Ravenwatch Keep.
hook: Kaelen, I need a favor that requires a subtle touch. A locket of mine, a beautiful Shimmering Sapphire, was stolen by a woman named Tamsin Quickstep. She's a ghost in the crowds of the Shifting Sands Bazaar. Could you find her, quietly liberate my locket, and return it to me?

hook: We have a delicate situation. One of our valued associates, Willa Stillwater the apothecary, may be targeted by some unsavory types in the Bazaar. We can't be seen to be playing favorites, but you could. Just stand by her, and if anyone gets any ideas, show them the error of their ways.

hook: The Corsairs think they own the docks. One of their Scaled Marauders has been shaking down honest merchants. I don't want you to kill anyone, but I want you to go down there and give that scaled bastard a beating he won't soon forget. Let's remind them who truly keeps order.

hook: I have a simple task for you, if you're not afraid of a little risk. A certain gaudy Shimmering Sapphire in Torvin Gemcutter's shop has caught my eye. I want it. Slip in, take it without him noticing, and bring it to me here in the Thicket. Do this, and you'll find the Syndicate very... grateful.

description: Kaelen Dawnseeker, a wizard of the Keepers of the Eternal Flame, has a deep-seated rivalry with Vespera Nocturne, a rogue mage who practices forbidden arts deep within the Wailing Caverns. Their feud has reached a tipping point, and Kaelen believes Vespera is planning a direct attack on the Sunken Cathedral. He trusts you implicitly and has asked you to travel to the Caverns, end Vespera's threat permanently, and return to confirm the deed is done.
hook: This is not a task I give lightly, my friend. Vespera Nocturne has delved too deep into the void. Her very presence is a blight, and she now threatens the Cathedral. I would not ask this of someone I did not trust completely. Go to the Wailing Caverns, find her, and do what must be done. Return to me, and we will speak no more of it, but know you will have my eternal gratitude.

A pack of Murkshade Stalkers has moved into a key ambush spot near their base in the Murkwood Thicket, making it impossible to use. He wants you to go in, thin their numbers by damaging a few, and report back so his crew can safely reclaim the area.
hook: You looking for a bit of work? Bloody Murkshade Stalkers have taken up residence in our favorite hunting ground. We can't move anything through there. Go make a mess of them—kill a few, wound the rest, I don't care—just scare them off. Come find me when you've made the place less... crowded.

description: Borin Ironfoot, the dwarven blacksmith of the Iron Concord, is furious. A rare Ancient Dwarven Coin from his personal collection was won in a crooked dice game by Rhys Larkspur, a fisherman who runs with the Saltspray Corsairs. Borin wants the coin back, but doesn't want to start a faction war. He's asked you to go to the Port Meridian Docks, quietly retrieve the coin from Rhys, and return it to his forge in Silvervein.
hook: That blasted sea-rat, Rhys Larkspur, made off with a priceless heirloom of my clan! An Ancient Dwarven Coin! I can't go down to those docks without starting a blood feud. You, though... you could slip in, lift it right from under his salt-encrusted nose, and bring it back to me. I'd owe you a great debt, and my forge would be at your service.

hook: We've heard chatter about some disgruntled former mercs heading toward the Grumpy Gruff. Eldon Bramblefoot runs a respectable establishment, and we don't want to see his place turned into a brawl pit. Head over there, keep your ears open, and make sure no one causes any trouble for the innkeeper.

hook: A scaly little wretch named Zarrik tried to pick my pocket in the Bazaar. He's with the Verdant Syndicate, so I can't just put an arrow in him without causing a political mess. But you could... 'educate' him. Find him lurking in the Murkwood and teach him the lesson that some pockets are better left unstuck.

hook: Hey, hey, you look like the quiet type. See, old Grizzle got some new Lockpick Sets in—real beauties. Problem is, the old gnome and I had a... misunderstanding. I can't get near his stall. You, though? You could slip in, grab a set, and meet me back here. Easy coin, yeah?

He believes this restless spirit is a blight that must be put to rest to purify the area. He trusts you to travel to the dangerous ruins, destroy the Legionnaire for good, and return to the Cathedral to report your success.
hook: I feel a chill in my bones, my friend. It emanates from the Sundered Peak Ruins—a Cursed Legionnaire, an ancient warrior trapped in undeath. Its presence is an open wound in the world. You have proven your spirit is strong. I beg of you, go to the ruins and bring this poor soul the final peace of oblivion. Return to me when it is done.

She wants you to go into the Thicket, injure the drake badly enough to drive it away, and then let her know the watering hole is safe again.
hook: See that spring over yonder? A damned Venomspitter Drake moved in. Nasty little bugger. We can't have it poisoning our people. Go rough it up—break a wing, give it a few good whacks, I don't care—just convince it to find a new home. Let me know when the coast is clear.

She's asked you to track Gideon to his hideout in the Wailing Caverns, recover the stolen Mandrake Root without killing him, and bring it to her at the Sunken Cathedral.
hook: Oh, bless you for coming. That scoundrel, Gideon Thorne, stole a pouch of Mandrake Root right out from under our noses! It's a vital ingredient for our work. hook: Quillan Reed is putting together a very... detailed report for us. Information like that makes people nervous. We expect someone might try to silence him. We need you to simply be present. Blend into the crowd near his stall and make sure no one disturbs his delicate work.

She wants you to go to the inn, sneak into the cellar or wherever Wendel keeps his private stash, and steal a bottle of that specific wine for her analysis.
hook: I've been trying to replicate the Grumpy Gruff's famous wine, but I'm missing something. Wendel Barleybrew, the farmer, has a private reserve he uses just for the inn. Their scouts have identified the culprit: a massive and unusually aggressive Stormfeather Harpy that has claimed the peak as her territory. This is a direct threat to their supply lines. As a proven ally, the Concord has tasked you with climbing to the ruins, slaying the harpy queen, and reporting your victory to Captain Valeria Stormborn at Ravenwatch Keep.
hook: This is a mission for our most trusted, Wayfarer. A Stormfeather Harpy has made a nest in the Sundered Peak Ruins and is slaughtering our patrols. We cannot let this stand. I need you to climb that peak, find the beast, and put it down for good. Report back to me when her screeching has been silenced forever.

A Fetid Corpsewalker has been lurking near the refuse pit behind the Grumpy Gruff Inn, scaring away her helpers and attracting more of its foul kind. She wants you to deal with it—damage it enough that it shambles off and doesn't come back—and then let her know it's safe for her to work again.
hook: Oh, it's just awful! One of those shambling Fetid Corpsewalkers has taken up residence by my refuse pit. The smell alone is bad enough, but the groaning is keeping me up at night! You look like you've got a strong arm. Go and give it a few good whacks with something heavy, would you? Just scare it off so I can get back to my sausages in peace!

hook: That snake-oil-selling rat, Lucian Ashford! He sold me a fake map and made off with my gold. He thinks he can hide in the Bazaar, but he's wrong. I want what's mine. You find that treacherous little weasel and you take that real map he's got squirreled away. Quiet-like. No need to kill him... yet. Just get me my map.

hook: One of our own turned sour has been sending nasty letters about our horses and the man who cares for them. Dorian Greymane is a good man and doesn't deserve to be looking over his shoulder. Post up at the stables for a while. If anyone so much as looks at Dorian funny, you have our permission to teach them some manners.

hook: Ysabel Draven thinks she's clever, brewing her poisons in the deep Thicket. She's planning something against us. I want you to remind her that her work has consequences. Find her. Break her vials, rough her up a bit. Just make sure she knows she's being watched, and her little project has been... delayed.

Seline believes such a valuable piece of intel belongs in the hands of the Quill. She wants you to travel to the Port Meridian Docks, steal the map from Mira, and deliver it to her in the Shifting Sands Bazaar.
hook: Mira Coldwater thinks she can just waltz around the Cathedral and draw a better map than me. The sheer audacity! That map is a work of art, and more importantly, it's accurate. It belongs in our archives, not in some damp Corsair hold. Go to the docks, lift it from her, and bring it to me. Let's show her where true skill lies.

Their leader has been identified and is known to be converting more members. In a rare move of direct action, the Syndicate has asked you—as someone they either trust deeply or want to test—to eliminate the cult leader. Travel to the Cathedral, find and kill the head Cultist, and report to Morwenna Shadowmere in the Murkwood Thicket.
hook: You wanted to prove your worth to the Verdant Syndicate? Here's your chance. A nest of Voidtouched Cultists has sprung up near the Cathedral, led by a particularly persuasive fanatic. They're bad for business. Go there. Silence their leader forever. Come find me when their little flock has scattered to the wind.

Recently, a Frostbite Wraith has taken up residence in one of the main tunnels, making passage nearly impossible. He wants you to go into the Caverns and deal with the spirit—you don't have to permanently destroy it, just damage its form enough to disrupt its presence for a while. Report back once the path is clear.
hook: Something cold and angry has moved into my favorite back passage. A bloody Frostbite Wraith. It's making my work a real chore. I just need it out of the way for a few days. Go in there, smack it around a bit with something magical if you have it, or just hit it really hard. I don't care. Just get it to dissipate so I can move through. I'll know when it's gone.

description: Lyra Silvertongue, a bard for the Silent Quill, is more than just a performer; she's an information gatherer. Her prized possession, a beautifully crafted instrument that doubles as a hidden document case, was stolen by Vanya Stormborn, a Corsair ranger, during a dockside brawl. Lyra wants it back without alerting the rest of the Corsairs. She needs you to go to the Port Meridian Docks, find Vanya, and quietly steal back her special Fine Elven Wine (the code word for her instrument case) and return it to her in the Shifting Sands Bazaar.
hook: Darling, a terrible injustice has been done. That brute, Vanya Stormborn, made off with my... let's call it a 'bottle of Fine Elven Wine'... during a scuffle on the docks. It's irreplaceable. Could you be a dear and pop down to Port Meridian to retrieve it for me? Discretion is key, of course. I wouldn't want her friends to know I came looking for it.

Rival gangs have been sniffing around. The Corsairs want you to provide overwatch—just stay near Anya and ensure she and the package are safe. If anyone tries to interfere, your job is to defend her.
hook: We've got a delicate handoff happening on the docks, and our girl Anya is running point. There are other sharks in these waters. We need an extra set of eyes who doesn't look like one of ours. Just shadow Anya Petrovna, keep quiet, and if anyone makes a move on her or the cargo, you put them down. Hard.

description: Durnan Flintheart, a dwarven blacksmith of the Iron Concord, has a long-standing grudge against Torvin Gemcutter, a rival jeweler in Silvervein Forge. Torvin has been spreading rumors that Durnan's metalwork is inferior. Durnan wants to settle the score the old-fashioned way—with fists, not words. He wants you to find Torvin in Silvervein and give him a sound beating to put the rumors to rest.
hook: That preening peacock, Torvin Gemcutter! He's been telling everyone my steel is brittle. My steel! The nerve! I'm too old for a proper brawl, but you're not. Go find that glitter-loving fool and give him a few good lumps from me. Tell him that's what real dwarven craft feels like.

He's asked you, someone he deeply trusts, to travel to the ruins, slay the troll, and bring him its tusks (by way of reporting back) so he can finally put the ghosts of his past to rest.
hook: I have waited long for this. A great beast lives in the Sundered Peak Ruins. A Cragjaw Troll. It is a killer of warriors. It took friends from me. I am not asking you to avenge them—I am asking you to bring me proof that the beast is dead. Go to the ruins. Find it. Kill it. And come back to tell me it is done. I will know then that their spirits can rest.

hook: Ulric Wolfsbane's head is getting too big for his helmet. He needs to be reminded that there is always someone stronger. I cannot be the one to do it. But you? You are not Iron Concord. hook: That stubborn mule, Durnan Flintheart, is sitting on a Shimmering Sapphire that would make a king weep. But his clumsy forge-hands would ruin it! She trusts you with the task: go to the Caverns, kill the Cultist, and report back to her at the Sunken Cathedral.
hook: Vespera Nocturne didn't work alone. One of her most devoted followers, a Voidtouched madman, still lurks in the depths of the Wailing Caverns, continuing her foul work. I want him ended. hook: First a Wraith, now a Banshee! These Caverns are getting crowded. This one's wailing is giving my contacts terrible headaches—can't get any good information out of them. Go find it and give it a good, hard disruption. I don't care if you can kill it or not, just get it to shut up for a while. I'll know when the screaming stops.

description: Rhys Larkspur, a simple fisherman who runs with the Corsairs, is superstitious. He believes his lucky fishing charm—a small, gaudy Gilded Skeleton Key—was stolen by a beggar named Percy Shortstep in the Shifting Sands Bazaar. Without it, he refuses to go to sea. He wants you to find Percy and get his lucky charm back, no questions asked.
hook: My lucky hook is gone! That little rat Percy Shortstep lifted it from me in the Bazaar, I just know it. It's a Gilded Skeleton Key, worthless as a real key, but it's my good luck charm. I ain't setting foot on a boat without it. You find that beggar and get my charm back, quiet-like. Don't hurt him too bad, just get my luck back.
