hook: Theron Oakenshield is prepping a wagonload of supplies for our men at Sundered Peak. Word is, some bandits are planning to hit it before it even leaves the Keep. We need an extra blade in the yard. Just stand with Theron until the wagon rolls out. If anyone comes looking for trouble, you give it to them.

Finnian Greycastle, a mercenary for the Verdant Syndicate, once desecrated a small shrine Aldric had blessed, and the memory still stings. Aldric would never order a man killed, but he feels a bit of physical retribution is in order. He wants you to find Finnian in the Murkwood Thicket and give him a beating in the name of the Eternal Flame.
hook: I try to live by the Flame's gentle light, but some men carry only darkness. Finnian Greycastle, a Syndicate thug, defiled a shrine of ours. I believe a lesson in physical humility might remind him that his actions have consequences. Find him in the Murkwood. Give him a thrashing he won't soon forget. Let it be a painful lesson.

She knows that Elowen Mosswood, a Keeper ranger, has been updating her personal Map of the Sunken Cathedral with new, detailed notes. Mira wants that map. She wants you to go to the Sunken Cathedral, find Elowen, and steal her annotated map to bring back to Port Meridian.
hook: Elowen Mosswood, that Keeper ranger, has been busy. She's got a map of the Cathedral with new routes and notes all over it. I need that information. The Corsairs pay well for good intel. Slip into the Cathedral grounds, find her, and 'borrow' that map for me. Bring it back to the docks, and there's a nice purse in it for you.

description: The dwarves of Silvervein Forge speak in hushed tones of the Rustvein Automatons—ancient, deadly constructs that guard the deepest parts of the Sundered Peak Ruins. One has recently become active and is a direct threat to dwarven artifact-hunting parties. Durnan Flintheart, a proud dwarf, sees this as an insult to his heritage. He has asked you, a trusted ally, to venture into the ruins, destroy the Automaton, and return to him with proof so he can honor your deed in the annals of his clan.
hook: Long ago, my ancestors built guardians for the deep places. Now, one of those Rustvein Automatons has gone mad and attacks its own makers' kin. This is an insult I cannot abide. I can't send my own people to die against such a thing, but you... you have proven yourself a warrior. Go to the Sundered Peak Ruins. Destroy that ancient monster. Bring me back word that it is done, and your name will be sung in my forge.

A nest of Boneweaver Spiders has infested the rafters, and their webs are obscuring the skylights. She needs someone to climb up there and get rid of them—damage them enough to drive them out or kill them—so she can get back to her star charts.
hook: My readings are all off! A whole nest of Boneweaver Spiders has webbed up my observatory's roof. I can't see a thing! I need someone with a strong arm and a lack of fear for heights to go up there and clear them out. Just smash them or tear down their webs, I don't care which. Just let me see the stars again!

description: Lucian Ashford, the thief, had just stolen a valuable signet ring (disguised as a Gilded Skeleton Key for transport) from a noble in the Bazaar when he was jumped on the docks by Yorick Grimjaw, a Lizardfolk Corsair. Grimjaw took the package, not knowing what it was, just that it was valuable. Lucian wants his prize back but can't risk a direct confrontation with the brutish Corsair. He wants you to go to the Port Meridian Docks, stealthily retrieve the Gilded Skeleton Key from Yorick, and bring it to him.
hook: I had a beautiful score... a noble's signet ring, disguised in a Gilded Skeleton Key case. Then that lumbering lizard, Yorick Grimjaw, decided he wanted it more and took it right off me. He's too strong to fight head-on. You, though... you look like you can be quiet. Sneak onto the docks, find him, and lift that key-case back for me. It's worth a lot of coin to both of us.

hook: Our girl Zephyra is meeting a new contact down by the docks. We don't know if this guy is on the level or if he's bringing friends. We need you to hang back and keep an eye on her. If things look good, you do nothing. If things go bad, you get her out of there in one piece.

Elowen wants you to find Reyna and teach her a lesson by giving her a good, non-lethal beating to drive her out of the area.
hook: That hunter, Reyna Redwood, has no respect. She's been taking more than her fair share from a grove that needs time to recover. Words won't sway her. I need you to find her and remind her, physically, that the Thicket has protectors. A few bruises should convince her to find new hunting grounds.

She wants you to find out where he sleeps, stealthily take his hidden Pouch of Gold Coins, and bring it to her in the Shifting Sands Bazaar.
hook: You see that pathetic beggar, Percy? Always moaning about copper pieces. I'm telling you, he's sitting on a real pile of gold somewhere. He's too scared to spend it, but I'm not. Find out where he sleeps, lift his stash, and meet me back in the Bazaar. We'll split the take... after I count it.

She has bided her time, but now she feels she has the ally she needs. She has asked you, a trusted friend, to go to the Port Meridian Docks, find this specific Marauder, and kill him to avenge her mentor. She asks you to report back not for glory, but for her own closure.
hook: Kaelen... I have never asked this of anyone before. There is a Scaled Marauder on the docks, one of Cyrus Blackwater's favorites. He has a scar across his left eye. He killed the woman who taught me everything I know. I need him dead. Not for the Concord, not for the war... for me. Can you do this? Find him, end him, and come back to tell me it's done.

hook: Curse these blasted Cinderborn Imps! They're everywhere! They singed my beard and made off with my favorite hammer! I can't work like this. Go on, get in there and shoo them away! Swat 'em, splash 'em, I don't care! Just get rid of the little pests and let me know when the forge is quiet again.

Yvette needs that specific herb for a powerful healing salve. She wants you to find Ophelia, steal the Silverleaf Herb back, and return it to her at the Sunken Cathedral.
hook: That woman! Ophelia Nightsong stole a whole patch of Silverleaf Herb I had been nurturing for months! It's a unique strain, perfect for a new salve I'm developing. I must have it back. Please, find her in the Thicket. I know it's asking much, but if you could retrieve my herbs—quietly—I would be eternally grateful. We must keep this from escalating into a larger conflict.

hook: The Empire is a beast with many heads, but this one is the most dangerous. General Tullius. He sits in Solitude, plotting our demise. I need you to end his command. Permanently. Do this, and you will be a hero of the Stormcloak rebellion.

description: Sven is distraught. He claims his lucky silver ring was stolen by Faendal, the elf, out of spite to ruin his upcoming performance. He's desperate to get it back, believing his musical talent will fail him without it.
hook: That pointy-eared menace, Faendal! He stole my good luck charm, a silver ring passed down in my family. He knows I have a big performance for the Jarl's men tonight. Please, I'm begging you, get it back from him.

hook: Farkas has a heart bigger than his brain sometimes. He's gone off to clear a wolf den east of the city, but he's been gone too long. Go make sure he's not bitten off more than he can chew. Watch his back.

hook: That self-righteous shield-maiden, Mjoll, is bad for business. She's scaring off clients and sweet-talks. I need you to put the fear of Nocturnal back into her. A good thrashing should remind her that Riften belongs to us.

hook: The secret to my new poison is just out of reach. That goody-goody Arcadia has the formula I need, scribbled on an old Garlic Braid in her shop. It's a warding talisman to her, but it's a recipe to me. Fetch it for me, little morsel.

hook: Maven Black-Briar. She thinks she's untouchable, that her gold and Guild make her safe. Someone with even deeper pockets disagrees. The contract is on her head. This will be a masterpiece of death. Do not fail the Brotherhood.

hook: A trade caravan should have arrived two days ago. I fear the worst. The road through the Rift is dangerous, and I've heard rumors of a huge snow cat hunting there. Please, can you see if the road is clear and deal with whatever is causing the delay?

hook: That's Skyforge Steel! My mark is on every ingot. Some gutter-trash from Riften stole a whole shipment. I'm told a lass named Vex was seen bragging about it. I can't leave my forge. You get my steel back from that thief!

hook: Delvin's in a tight spot. He's moving a Dwarven Cog worth a fortune, but we've heard chatter that someone might try to hit the deal. I need you to watch his back. Make sure the exchange goes smooth and Delvin walks away with the gold.

hook: Galmar is the brains behind their logistics. Without him, their troops go hungry and their steel runs dull. He's inspecting a warehouse by the docks tonight. Give him a 'performance review' from the Empire. He'll get the message.

hook: Calcelmo is such a hoarder! He has a Dwarven Cog with the most *exquisite* tonal architecture schematics etched into it, and he won't share! I must have it for my research. Just pop over to his study in the Underkeep and... liberate it for me.

hook: A true son or daughter of Skyrim does not just fight men, but the wild itself. A great beast terrorizes my people. Slay this Giant Frost Troll, and prove you have the heart of a Stormcloak warrior. Bring me its pelt as proof.

hook: Crawling filth. The lower chambers are crawling with Frostbite Spiders again. It's undignified for an assassin of my caliber to be squashing bugs. Clear them out so I can get to the weapons stores. Try not to get any venom on the floor.

hook: An Amulet of Stendarr, stolen right from under the temple's roof! This is a blasphemy I cannot ignore. My guards are useless. You, however... you have a certain look about you. Find the amulet and return it. Discretion is paramount.

description: The Dark Brotherhood has a strict hierarchy, and not everyone is pleased with Cicero's presence in the Sanctuary. You are to secretly watch over Cicero and ensure he comes to no harm.
hook: The jester is... an acquired taste. But he is a member of this family. Some within these walls might forget that. Watch over Cicero. Be his silent protector. If anyone tries to put a blade in his back, you have our blessing to put one in theirs.

hook: Hemming Black-Briar is a snake who preys on the weak. He's been taking 'protection' money from the fishmongers. His mother thinks she owns this city. Let's show her she doesn't own justice. Find Hemming and give him a taste of Riften steel.

description: Calcelmo is livid. That 'feather-brained' Wylandriah in Riften has a Dwarven Cog of his that she 'borrowed' and never returned. He's beyond asking nicely. He wants you to retrieve his property by any means necessary. He has given you permission to use lethal force if she resists.
hook: That infuriating woman! She's had my tonal resonator cog for months! I've sent letters. I've sent couriers. She just ignores me. Go to her little alchemy den in Riften and get my property back. I don't care how you do it. She's had her chance.

description: The civil war has dragged on long enough. General Tullius has decided that the only way to end the rebellion is to cut off its head. He is giving you a direct, clandestine order: infiltrate the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm and assassinate Ulfric Stormcloak. This will end the war in a single stroke.
hook: Ulfric is the rebellion. Without his voice, his followers are just a rabble. I'm giving you a chance to end this war before thousands more die. Kill Ulfric Stormcloak. Do this, and the Empire will be in your debt. Do not fail.

hook: My workers are a superstitious, cowardly lot. They think a few overgrown Skeevers in the cellar are a sign from the gods. I think they're just pests. Go down there and clear them out. I have a business to run.

hook: I lent that scatterbrain Wylandriah a book. Or perhaps she just took it. It's a simple spell tome, but it has all my notes on flame augmentation! Go to Riften and see if my book has somehow wandered into her possession. Try to be... polite.

description: Jarl Balgruuf is making a short but politically sensitive trip to a nearby farm to settle a land dispute. Proventus Avenicci, his steward, fears it could be a trap set by Imperial or Stormcloak sympathizers. He's hiring you as extra, discreet security for the Jarl.
hook: The Jarl is a stubborn man. He insists on settling this dispute personally. I don't like it. The roads aren't safe. I need someone capable to accompany him. Stay close, stay quiet, and if anything happens... well, you know what to do.

description: Faendal is tired of Sven's arrogance and the way he brags about his (mostly fictional) heroic deeds to Camilla. He wants you to give Sven a good, old-fashioned beating to put him in his place and maybe even blacken his eye so he can't perform for a few days.
hook: Sven's been filling Camilla's head with more of his ridiculous stories. Someone needs to teach that pompous poet a lesson in humility. A few bruises should shut him up for a while. Consider it a public service to all of Riverwood.

description: Hod wants to surprise his wife, Gerdur, with a beautiful Blue Mountain Flower for their anniversary, but he's too clumsy to find one himself without crushing it. He also wants it to be a surprise, so he asks you to 'find' the one she keeps pressed in her favorite book and bring it to him so he can re-gift it.
hook: Gerdur loves those Blue Mountain Flowers. She's got one pressed in her big book of tales. I want to give her a 'new' one on our anniversary, see? It's the thought that counts. Could you sneak in and get that flower for me? She'll never know it's the same one.

description: A reclusive alchemist has paid the Dark Brotherhood a fortune for a rare ingredient: the poison sac of a Chaurus Reaper from the depths of Blackreach. This is less an assassination and more a hunt. The Brotherhood is sending you to prove your lethality against the most dangerous of beasts.
hook: This is an unusual contract. No man or mer to kill. The target is a beast. A Chaurus Reaper, deep in Blackreach. Our client needs its poison. The gold is good, and the challenge is... exciting. Bring back proof of the kill.

description: Travelers heading to Falkreath from the north are being attacked by giant Frostbite Spiders emerging from Bleak Falls Barrow. Jarl Siddgeir is more annoyed by the disruption to trade than concerned for his people, but he wants it dealt with nonetheless.
hook: My hold's roads are supposed to be safe, and now I hear of giant spiders from that cursed barrow scaring off merchants. It's bad for business. Go up there and kill a few of the big ones. That should send the rest scurrying back into the dark.

hook: I've been a fool. My client list... it's gone. A little silver ring with some special markings. I think Maven's got her claws on it. If she deciphers it, she owns half my contacts. Get that ring back for me, and be quiet about it. Our Guild's secrets are at stake.

description: Ralof of Riverwood is carrying crucial war plans from Windhelm to a Stormcloak camp in the Rift. Imperial spies are everywhere. You are tasked with shadowing Ralof on the first leg of his journey to ensure he leaves the city safely and isn't ambushed.
hook: Ralof carries our future in his satchel. The Imperials would love to get their hands on those plans. I need a quiet shadow to watch his back as he leaves the city. Get him safely past the gates and onto the southern road.

description: Uthgerd the Unbroken is bored and itching for a real fight. She's heard you're tough and wants to test your mettle in a fistfight behind the Bannered Mare. The prize? Her respect, and maybe a few coins she'll bet on herself to lose.
hook: You look like you've seen a scrap or two. I'm tired of beating up on drunk farmers. Let's you and me have a real go. Fists only. I want to see if you're as tough as the whispers say. Don't hold back.

hook: I need to butter up a mark, but mother keeps me on a short leash. Jarl Siddgeir in Falkreath has some rare mead in his personal larder. Swipe a few bottles. It'll make the perfect gift and cost me nothing. Just don't get caught.

description: A powerful Spriggan Earthmother in the Rift has been corrupted by something dark in the forest. It's no longer a protector of nature but a malicious force, killing any who enter its grove. Kodlak sees this as a worthy challenge for a new Companion, a fight against a true monster.
hook: The wilds are out of balance. A Spriggan, a creature meant to protect nature, has turned cruel and murderous. This is no common beast. It is a test of your spirit as much as your strength. Find its grove and cleanse the corruption from this world.

hook: Blasted creatures! They're everywhere down by the docks, pinching and snapping. The fishermen are afraid to wade in. It's a simple, dirty job, but someone has to do it. Clear those Mudcrabs out before we all starve.

hook: That weasel Belethor! He knew those ingots were promised to me! He's got them locked up in his shop. I'm not asking you to steal from him... I'm asking you to repossess my property. Get me those Iron Ingots.

description: Hadvar has been sent back to Riverwood to visit his family, but Legion command fears it might be a trap set by Stormcloak sympathizers who know his patrol schedule. They want you to discreetly watch over him during his stay in the village.
hook: Hadvar's a good soldier, but his heart sometimes overrules his head. He's visiting family in Riverwood, a village with... divided loyalties. We want someone there to watch his six. Keep him safe, but don't let him know you're there. He'd hate it.

hook: Dorthe is so mean! She called me a milk-drinker and threw mud on my new tunic! I'm not allowed to hit girls... but you're not from Riverwood. Can you push her in the big puddle by the mill? That'll teach her!

hook: A Daedra Heart. The pinnacle of alchemy. Eorlund Gray-Mane has one, the old goat. He uses it for his metalwork, the fool. I need it for my potions. I don't care how you get it from him. Just bring me that heart. Quietly, of course.

hook: Some conjurer on Solstheim thinks he can use Oblivion to wage a private war on the Empire. He has a Dremora Kynval at his command. We need you to banish that beast back to Oblivion and ensure the mage never casts another spell. This is a job for a legionnaire who doesn't flinch.

hook: My Dorthe is scared to play outside. There's an Icefang and its pack lurking in the trees. My hammer is for steel, not beasts. You look like you can handle a bow or blade. Clear those wolves out before they hurt someone.

hook: That elf is poisoning Camilla against me. I need to show her his true nature. Faendal has these fancy Elven Arrows. If one were to go missing and somehow find its way into my house... well, it would look like he was trying to hex me, wouldn't it? You'd be doing me a great service.

description: Hrongar, the Jarl's brother, is a great warrior but a terrible watchman. Irileth is worried he'll fall asleep on his shift atop the city walls. She wants you to join him on watch tonight, keep him awake, and ensure the walls are properly guarded against any surprises.
hook: Hrongar is a good man with an axe, but put him on watch duty and he's snoring louder than a mammoth. I need you to go up on the walls with him tonight. Make sure he stays awake, and more importantly, make sure nothing slips past the gates.

hook: That pompous mage, Marcurio. He's been taking jobs meant for me, and then brags about it in every tavern from here to Riften. I don't have time to hunt him down myself. Find him and give him a few bruises to remind him to keep my name out of his mouth.

hook: Delvin's been holding out on us. He's got this little Dwarven Cog he's tinkered with, and I swear on Nocturnal, it's the best lockpick in Skyrim. He won't share. So we'll just have to borrow it. Permanently. It's on his bench in the Flagon. Get it for me.

hook: My grandfather used to tell a story about a guardian wight in that old barrow on the mountain. He said it watched over a treasure. I always thought it was a tall tale. But now... well, a man can dream. Find that Skeletal Wight, put it back in its grave, and bring me something shiny from its hoard.

hook: Please, mister/miss! There's a horrible, giant rat under the porch! It has red eyes and it's this big! My dolly is down there and I'm so scared! Can you go and make the monster go away?

Nazir is giving you this prestigious contract as a final test of your loyalty and skill. Killing such a well-connected and well-guarded man in his own city will be the pinnacle of your career with the Brotherhood.
hook: This is it. The big one. A contract on Brynjolf of the Thieves Guild. He's charming, he's clever, and he's always surrounded by his cutthroats. This will require planning, skill, and a cold heart. Bring me word of his death, and your place in this family is forever secure.

hook: There's a bounty on some troublemakers outside the city walls. Head out, rough them up a bit, and when you're done, come back and let me know the roads are safe again.

hook: This is a disaster! A priceless Elder Scroll has been stolen from right under our noses. I have it on good authority the Thieves Guild in Riften is behind it. I need you to get it back for me. Quietly, of course.

hook: Whelps. The feud between Gray-Mane and Battle-Born goes too far if they'd disturb the honored dead. We've been asked to stand watch over Fralia while she mourns. Go. Let nothing past you.

hook: Do you hear that racket? That fanatic Heimskr never shuts up about Talos and his 'mighty Stormcloaks.' It's treasonous talk. Someone ought to give him a few bruises to help him remember his place. You look like just the person.

hook: My shop was robbed! They took everything, but most importantly, a solid gold claw. It's my family's legacy. They've fled to Bleak Falls Barrow. Please, I need a skilled adventurer to get it back for me. I'll make it worth your while.

hook: Shor's bones, I've been a fool. I lost a bet to that pompous cloud-sucker, Nazeem. He wants me to... well, never mind what he wants. I need his prized sapphire. If you can 'acquire' it from his house without anyone seeing, I can get him to call off the debt. Can you help a shield-brother out?

hook: It seems the dead don't rest easy in Solitude. The lingering spirit of Queen Potema has attracted a large pack of wolves to the temple's catacombs. They're becoming a danger. Go down there, drive them off or put them down, and then report back to me.

hook: A patrol was cut down by a bandit who got her hands on a weapon of mine. An Elven dagger, a personal gift from the Jarl. I want it back, and I want her head on a pike. You go to their camp near Riften, do what needs to be done, and bring my dagger back to me.

hook: We have it on good authority that some Stormcloak sympathizers are planning to ambush one of our own, Olfrid Battle-Born. We need someone not in uniform to make sure he gets to the stables and back in one piece. Can you handle it?

description: Uthgerd the Unbroken has a long-standing grudge against Sinmir. She claims he insulted her honor in a mead hall years ago. She wants the Dragonborn to challenge Sinmir to a brawl and teach him a lesson, proving that Uthgerd's champion is stronger.
hook: You see that layabout Sinmir over there? Calls himself a warrior. He once called me a milk-drinker. I'd cave his face in myself, but I'm forbidden from brawling inside the city gates. You, though... you could teach him some respect. A few well-placed punches from you, in my name, would settle a score.

description: Brynjolf has a special task from an 'outside client' to put Maven Black-Briar in her place. He wants the Dragonborn to break into Maven's manor in Riften and steal a Flawless Sapphire she keeps in a locked safe, just to show her that she isn't as untouchable as she believes.
hook: Got a delicate job, lad/lass. A certain client with deep pockets wants to send a message to our 'friend' Maven Black-Briar. A reminder that even her locks have keys. She has a beautiful, flawless sapphire. I need you to lift it from her manor. Quiet as a shadow.

hook: I have observed your... talents. And your lack of ties to this crumbling institution. I have reason to believe Savos Aren is a traitor to peace. Prove yourself to the Thalmor. Deal with him. Permanently. And then, tell me it is done.

hook: By the Eight, I can't go down to my own cellar without getting bitten! It's crawling with skeevers. I'd do it myself, but I've got an inn to run. Could you go down there and clear the little monsters out for me? I'll pay you in ale and coin!

description: Viarmo, the headmaster of the Bards College, is distraught. A priceless flute that once belonged to a famous composer was stolen by a traveling merchant who was last seen heading for Riften. He asks the Dragonborn to travel to Riften, track down the merchant, and 'recover' the instrument.
hook: A tragedy! The Flute of Fjolmund Fair-Wind has been stolen! Our entire performance of 'The Saga of the Dragonborn' is ruined without it. The thief was last seen in Riften. Please, you must get it back. The college's reputation depends on it!

description: Mallus Maccius wants to sabotage his rival, Sabjorn, the owner of Honningbrew Meadery. He's asked the Dragonborn to sneak into the meadery's main hall and steal a rare cask of Honningbrew Reserve that Sabjorn is planning to present to the Jarl, ruining his big moment.
hook: Sabjorn thinks he's so high and mighty with his fancy mead. He's got a special cask he's gifting to the Jarl next week. I want to see the look on his face when it's 'missing.' Sneak into the meadery, find that cask, and bring it to me. We'll split the profits from selling it.

description: Viola Giordano is convinced there is a serial killer, the 'Butcher,' preying on the women of Windhelm. Her investigation has led her to suspect the strange antique dealer, Calixto Corrium. She has no proof for the guards, so she turns to the Dragonborn, pleading for a more direct form of justice.
hook: The guards are useless! They won't listen to a 'crazy old woman.' But I know it's him. That man, Calixto, who runs the odd little shop. He's a monster. I can see it in his eyes. You're the only one who can stop him. Please... end the Butcher before he strikes again.

description: Froki Whetted-Blade, an old hunter living in the mountains, believes Kyne's sacred creatures are being defiled by a rogue sabre cat that has gone mad with bloodlust. He tasks the Dragonborn with hunting this 'Guardian Beast' to test their skill and restore balance to the wilds.
hook: Kyne's wind speaks of a great predator gone mad. A sabre cat, a beast of her domain, that now kills for sport, not for food. It defiles the hunt. Go. Face it in combat. Prove you are a true hunter, worthy of Kyne's blessing.

He tasks the Dragonborn with a daring mission: infiltrate Dragonsreach in Whiterun and steal the Elder Scroll.
hook: That Imperial puppet in Whiterun, Farengar, is studying an Elder Scroll. No good can come of a wizard who serves the Empire possessing such power. We need to know what he knows. I need you to get into Dragonsreach and 'liberate' that scroll. Bring it to Ulfric. He'll know how to use it.

description: The Thieves Guild has a... tenant, an old man named Esbern hiding in the Ratway Warrens. They've heard that Thalmor agents are in Riften, asking questions about an 'old Blade.' The Guild doesn't care about politics, but they don't want a bloodbath in their territory. They ask the Dragonborn to guard the entrance to the Ratway Warrens and ensure no Thalmor get in.
hook: Listen, we've got an old geezer hiding out in the Warrens. Normally we don't care, but some Thalmor types are sniffing around. If they find him, it'll cause a ruckus we don't need. Go down there and make sure no pointy-eared, gold-armored snobs get past you. Keep the peace in the Ratway.

description: Ulfric Stormcloak is tired of Balgruuf's neutrality. He wants to send a clear message that his indecision will not be tolerated. He asks the Dragonborn to confront Jarl Balgruuf in his own hall and rough him up, a public humiliation to show the people of Whiterun that their Jarl is weak.
hook: Balgruuf sits on his wooden throne, playing at being neutral while true Nords bleed for their freedom. He is a coward. I want you to go to Dragonsreach and give him a 'reminder' of what happens to those who do not choose a side. Beat him within an inch of his life and leave him groveling on the floor. That will be his message.

description: Nurelion, the elderly alchemist in Windhelm, is on his deathbed. His apprentice, Quintus Navale, has taken the legendary White Phial from the shop and refuses to give it back, claiming Nurelion is too ill to work with it. Nurelion, in his final days, asks the Dragonborn to retrieve his most prized possession so he can see it one last time.
hook: *Cough*... That fool boy, Quintus. He took it... the White Phial. My life's work. He thinks he's protecting me, but he's just a thief. Please... you're strong. Go to my shop, get my phial back from him. I need to see it... before I meet Arkay.

description: Senna, a priestess of Dibella in Markarth, is distraught. A beautiful and sacred statue of the goddess was stolen from the temple during a Forsworn raid. She needs a strong warrior to venture into the Forsworn-controlled hills, fight the raiders, and retrieve the statue of the Heart of Dibella.
hook: They defiled our temple! The Forsworn, those savages, they broke in and stole our statue of Dibella, the Heart of our faith. Please, I can't ask the city guard, they wouldn't survive the hills. You have a warrior's spirit. Find the savages, bring our goddess home.

description: Karliah has finally tracked down Mercer Frey, the traitor who murdered the previous Guildmaster and left her for dead. She has a plan to corner him in an old dwarven ruin near Whiterun. She needs the Dragonborn's help to finish him once and for all and restore the Thieves Guild to its former glory. This is a mission of pure revenge.
hook: I've found him. That traitor, Mercer. He's hiding in a dwarven ruin, Irkngthand. He thinks he's safe, but he's wrong. This ends now. Help me, and we will avenge Gallus and cleanse the Guild of his poison forever. When it's done, we tell Brynjolf the good news.

description: Jaree-Ra, a shady Argonian in Solitude, has a plan to rob his sister Deeja's ship, the Icerunner. He wants the Dragonborn to sneak aboard the ship, which is docked at the Solitude harbor, and steal its prized figurehead, known as 'The Dainty Sload.' He claims she stole it from him, and this is just 'getting back what's his.'
hook: My sister, Deeja. She's a cold one, even for a lizard. She stole something precious from me—the figurehead from our family's ship. She's got it on her new boat, the Icerunner. I want it back. Sneak on board, pry it off the bow, and bring it to me. We'll teach her a lesson about family.

input: {"NPCs":{"DanicaPureSpring":{"Name":"Danica Pure-Spring","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun","OwnedItems":{"HealthPotion":10,"BlueMountainFlower":5},"Role":"Priest","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Heimskr","Favorability":-15}]},"Heimskr":{"Name":"Heimskr","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun","Faction":"Stormcloaks","Role":"Priest"}},"Locations":{"Whiterun":{"Name":"Whiterun"}},"Items":{"HealthPotion":{"Type":"Potion","Name":"Health Potion"},"Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Septim"}}}

description: Danica Pure-Spring wishes to perform a ritual at the Gildergreen, the great tree in the center of Whiterun. However, she fears that Heimskr, who sees her worship as 'Imperial heresy,' might try to disrupt or even attack her. She asks the Dragonborn to stand nearby and ensure she can complete her prayers to Kynareth in peace.
hook: I must commune with Kynareth at the Gildergreen, to feel her blessings for the healing I do. But that loud-mouthed fanatic Heimskr has been glaring at me. He's threatened to 'purge' my 'false faith.' I am no warrior. Would you stand guard for me, for just a little while? Ensure I am not disturbed.

She asks the Dragonborn to clear out the giant frostbite spiders that have taken over the building so she can safely search the premises without getting poisoned.
hook: I've tracked a skooma shipment to a warehouse by the docks, but the place is crawling with spiders the size of dogs. I can't search for evidence if I have to watch my back every second. You look capable. Go in there and clear the beasts out for me. I'll handle the rest.

description: Carlotta Valentia is fed up with Mikael the bard's constant, unwanted advances. He writes her lurid poems and follows her around the market. She wants the Dragonborn to teach him a lesson. Not kill him, but beat him badly enough that the very thought of a love song makes his ribs ache.
hook: That... that bard. Mikael. He's a menace. He won't leave me alone! He follows me, he sings about me... it's humiliating. My husband would have... but he's gone. Please, I can't stand it anymore. Could you... rough him up? Make him think twice before he writes another 'ode' to me.

description: Calcelmo, the court wizard in Markarth, has activated a powerful and hostile Dwarven Sphere in the depths of Nchuand-Zel that he cannot deactivate. The automaton is now patrolling a section of the ruin, preventing him from accessing a valuable research chamber. He needs the Dragonborn to destroy the ancient machine so he can continue his work.
hook: A fascinating, yet infuriating, predicament! I managed to activate a Dwarven Sphere, but its combat protocols are stuck. It thinks I'm an intruder! It's guarding a hallway I absolutely must access. My magic is useless against its ancient shielding. I need someone with more... physical talents to dismantle it. Permanently.

description: Maramal, the priest of Mara in Riften, had a blessed Amulet of Mara stolen from the temple's donation box. He knows it's a petty theft by a local scoundrel who is trying to pawn it. He asks the Dragonborn to find the thief in the Ratway and retrieve the sacred amulet.
hook: Blessings of Mara upon you. A sad business... one of our sacred amulets was stolen from the donation box. It's just a petty thief, but the amulet was a gift from a loving couple. It means a great deal. Could you track down the scoundrel and retrieve it? I have little coin, but I can pay for its safe return.

input: {"NPCs":{"ViolaGiordano":{"Name":"Viola Giordano","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Windhelm","CurrentLocation":"Windhelm","Role":"Merchant"}},"Factions":{"Stormcloaks":{"Name":"Stormcloaks","DefaultLocation":"Windhelm"}},"Locations":{"Windhelm":{"Name":"Windhelm"}},"Items":{"Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Septim"}}}

description: With a serial killer on the loose in Windhelm, the Stormcloak leadership is concerned about the public perception of their ability to keep the city safe. They know Viola Giordano is poking around and could become the next victim. They ask the Dragonborn to serve as a discreet bodyguard for the old woman until the killer is caught.
hook: This 'Butcher' business is making the city look weak. That old bat, Viola, is going to get herself killed if she keeps asking questions. We don't need another body turning up in the graveyard. Keep an eye on her. Make sure she stays safe. It'll show the people we're still in control here.

description: Eydis, the innkeeper of Old Hroldan Inn, is having trouble with a Hagraven that has taken up residence in the nearby hills. The creature's foul magic is scaring away travelers and spoiling her food stores. She asks the Dragonborn to drive the Hagraven away from the inn's vicinity.
hook: It's bad for business, you see. A wretched Hagraven has made a nest just up the hill. My guests are terrified, and my last batch of mead turned to vinegar overnight! I don't have much, but I can pay if you'll just go and get rid of the foul thing.

description: Lod, the blacksmith in Falkreath, has been pestered by a strange talking dog to find a lost artifact: the Rueful Axe. He wants it just to get the dog to leave him alone. He's learned a powerful vampire in a cave near Whiterun has it. He asks the Dragonborn to retrieve the axe so he can finally get some peace and quiet.
hook: You look like you've seen a lot. Maybe you can help me with a strange problem. There's a dog. Talks. Won't leave me alone about some axe. I've heard a rumor a vampire has it in a cave near Whiterun. I'm a blacksmith, not a vampire hunter. You get that axe for me, I'll pay you well, and maybe this infernal dog will finally shut up.

description: Mirabelle Ervine is deeply suspicious of Ancano's activities in the College of Winterhold. She believes he has acquired a dangerous artifact, the Staff of Magnus, and is keeping it in his quarters for some nefarious purpose. She asks the Dragonborn to discreetly enter Ancano's room and take the staff, so she can study it and find out what he's planning.
hook: That Thalmor snake, Ancano, has been sneaking around the college. I have reason to believe he's gotten his hands on something powerful and dangerous, something he keeps in his quarters. I need someone who can get in and out without him knowing. Can you 'borrow' whatever he's hiding in there and bring it to me? For the good of the College.

input: {"NPCs":{"AvulsteinGrayMane":{"Name":"Avulstein Gray-Mane","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun","Faction":"Stormcloaks","OwnedItems":{"IronSword":1,"Lockpick":3},"Role":"Warrior","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Factions":{"ImperialLegion":{"Name":"Imperial Legion","DefaultLocation":"Solitude"}},"Locations":{"Markarth":{"Name":"Markarth"},"Whiterun":{"Name":"Whiterun"}},"Items":{"SteelArmor":{"Type":"Armor","Name":"Steel Armor"}}}

description: Avulstein Gray-Mane is desperate. His brother Thorald was captured by the Imperial Legion and handed over to the Thalmor. He's been a prisoner in a secret Thalmor camp near Markarth for weeks. Avulstein can't ask the Jarl for help, as it would expose his Stormcloak ties. He asks the Dragonborn to storm the Thalmor camp, kill the guards, and free Thorald, proving their loyalty to the family and Skyrim.
hook: They took my brother. The Imperials and their Thalmor masters. He's being held in some secret prison to the west, being tortured for information. The guards will pay for what they've done. I can't do this alone. Will you help me get my brother back? Storm the camp and kill every last one of those Thalmor scum.

input: {"NPCs":{"MavenBlackBriar":{"Name":"Maven Black-Briar","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Riften","CurrentLocation":"Riften","Role":"Merchant"},"ProventusAvenicci":{"Name":"Proventus Avenicci","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun","Faction":"ImperialLegion","Role":"Steward","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun":{"Name":"Whiterun"}},"Items":{"Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Septim"}}}

description: Maven Black-Briar is annoyed with Proventus Avenicci. He's been putting tariffs on her mead shipments into Whiterun, cutting into her profits. She wants to send a 'clear message' to the Jarl's steward about the consequences of meddling in her business. She asks the Dragonborn to find Proventus and beat him to a bloody pulp.
hook: That little Imperial bootlicker, Proventus. He thinks he can tax *my* mead. He needs a reminder of who he's dealing with. I want you to pay him a visit in Whiterun. Break a few of his fingers. Let him know that the next time he touches my profits, it'll be more than his hand that gets broken.

description: Ysolda had a wild night drinking with a stranger named Sam Guevenne. The next morning, she woke up in Markarth missing her most prized possession: a beautiful silver and garnet ring she was saving for her future wedding. She needs the Dragonborn to go to Markarth, find out where she was, and get her ring back from whoever has it.
hook: Oh, my head... and my ring is gone! I went out for a few drinks with a man named Sam, and the next thing I knew I was in a temple in Markarth with a terrible hangover and an empty pocket. That ring was meant for my wedding day! Please, you have to help me find it. I'll pay you whatever I can.

description: Jaree-Ra is planning a heist on the Icerunner but needs a distraction. The Thieves Guild asks the Dragonborn to act as a lookout and guard for Jaree-Ra while he works on the docks. If any Solitude guards get too curious, the Dragonborn's job is to intervene—either by talking them away or, if necessary, fighting them off—to ensure Jaree-Ra isn't caught.
hook: Jaree-Ra has a little job lined up on the Solitude docks. He needs a second pair of eyes and a strong arm to keep the city watch off his back. Go down there and just... watch over him. If a guard comes sniffing around, you make sure they don't bother him. He gets caught, we all look bad.

description: The Silver Hand, a group of werewolf hunters, has been attacking Companions on the roads. Aela the Huntress has tracked their leader, Krev the Skinner, to a hideout near Whiterun. Consumed by fury, she asks the Dragonborn to join her in a pre-emptive strike to wipe them out, focusing their vengeance on Krev.
hook: The Silver Hand. Cowards who attack from the shadows. They've spilled the blood of the pack, and for that, they must pay. I've found where their leader, Krev, is hiding. I want his head. Come with me, shield-sibling. Let's paint their walls with the blood of hunters.

description: Evette San, a food vendor in Solitude, is furious. Vittoria Vici, the Emperor's cousin, is getting married and has bought up the entire supply of the rare Spiced Wine that Evette needs for her famous holiday treats. Evette just wants a single cask to fulfill her regular customers' orders. She asks the Dragonborn to 'acquire' one for her from the East Empire Company Warehouse.
hook: It's a travesty! That pampered noble, Vittoria Vici, has bought every last drop of Spiced Wine in the city for her lavish wedding. I only need one cask to make my spiced sweets for my regular customers! It's not fair. You look like the type who can get into places. If you could just... find a cask for me in the warehouse, I'd be ever so grateful.

description: Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone of Morthal has had visions of a vampire lurking in the swamps, preying on travelers. The townsfolk are terrified. While she knows a lone vampire isn't a major threat, its presence is causing panic. She asks the Dragonborn to venture into the swamp, find the creature, and destroy it, restoring a sense of safety to her hold.
hook: My visions show me a creature of the night, a vampire, stalking the mists of our swamp. The people are scared, and their fear feeds the darkness. Find this beast. Put it to the sword or flame. Do this, and bring back peace of mind to my people.

description: Avrusa Sarethi, an alchemist living on a farm outside Riften, is trying to cultivate the rare Crimson Nirnroot. She had a single sample she was using for her research, but it was stolen by Falmer who raided her farm and fled back into the depths of Blackreach. She needs an adventurer brave enough to enter the underground realm and retrieve the precious plant.
hook: My life's work, gone! I had a perfect Crimson Nirnroot specimen, and those vile Falmer stole it. They dragged it down into the dark, back to Blackreach. I can't go down there, it's a death trap! Please, if you're as brave as you look, you must get it back for me. It's the key to my research.

description: Madesi, the Argonian jeweler in Riften, is expecting a shipment of rare gems. He's heard rumors that the Thieves Guild might try to intercept it at the city gates. He asks the Dragonborn to simply be present when the shipment arrives, to stand guard over him and his goods and ensure they reach his market stall safely.
hook: I have a very important shipment arriving today. Rare stones from Morrowind. I have a bad feeling... whispers that the Thieves Guild might try to... 'inspect' it before it gets to me. You are strong, yes? Could you just... stand with me when the courier arrives? Walk with us to my stall. Just your presence should be enough to deter any trouble.

description: Alfhild Battle-Born has caught Jervar, a Gray-Mane sympathizer, spreading rumors that her family's produce is cursed. She wants the Dragonborn to confront Jervar and 'put the fear of the divines' back into him, teaching him to keep his mouth shut about the Battle-Borns.
hook: That sniveling farmhand, Jervar. I overheard him telling people my cabbages are 'blighted' because of my family's 'Imperial sympathies.' The nerve! He's just a Gray-Mane lapdog. Someone needs to teach him a lesson about spreading lies. Go find him and give him a few new bruises to remember me by.

description: Vex has gotten word that a noble in Riften has one of the Unusual Gems, the Stones of Barenziah, in their home. She finds them a personal challenge and wants the Dragonborn to retrieve it for her. It's a test of skill and a way to add to the Guild's growing collection of these mysterious jewels.
hook: You see that fancy house over there? I've heard the owner has a very special rock. One of those 'Stones of Barenziah.' It's worthless to them, just a pretty bauble. But to me, it's a puzzle. Get in there, lift it, and bring it to me. Let's see if you have the touch.

input: {"NPCs":{"Tyranus":{"Name":"Tyranus","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Markarth","CurrentLocation":"Markarth","Role":"Priest"},"LogrolfTheWillful":{"Name":"Logrolf the Willful","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Markarth","CurrentLocation":"Markarth","Role":"Priest"}},"Locations":{"Markarth":{"Name":"Markarth"}},"Items":{"MaceOfMolagBal":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Mace of Molag Bal"}}}

description: Tyranus, a Vigilant of Stendarr, is investigating an abandoned house in Markarth that he believes is a site of Daedric worship. He suspects a priest of Boethiah, Logrolf the Willful, is involved and hiding somewhere in the city. He wants the Dragonborn's help to track down the priest and kill him, cleansing the house of its evil taint.
hook: This house... it reeks of Oblivion. I've tracked its foul energy to a priest of Boethiah, Logrolf. He's somewhere in the hills. He must be brought to justice, his soul cleansed by fire. Aid me in this holy mission, and together we will strike a blow against the Daedra.

input: {"NPCs":{"VekelTheMan":{"Name":"Vekel the Man","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Windhelm","CurrentLocation":"Windhelm","Role":"Innkeeper"}},"Locations":{"Windhelm":{"Name":"Windhelm","Enemies":["IceWraith","Bear"]}},"Enemies":{"IceWraith":{"Name":"Ice Wraith","Loot":[]}},"Items":{"ArgonianAle":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Argonian Ale"},"Septim":{"Type":"Currency","Name":"Septim"}}}

hook: That golem guards something important—we're sure of it. We can't study what we can't reach. Disable it, and you'll have our gratitude and first pick of any mundane treasures we find.

hook: Those sheep were my livelihood! Ophelia's probably already eaten them by now. Take whatever supplies she has—it won't bring back my flock, but it's something.

hook: Some sore loser thinks I water down my ale. Ha! I'd never dishonor dwarven brewing traditions. Still, he might cause trouble tonight. Watch my back, and you'll drink free.

hook: Draven's been moving in on my territory. The Hand respects strength. Show them Draven is weak, and my position improves. It's just business.

hook: Know your enemy's movements, and you've already won half the battle. Grimble keeps the shipping schedules in his office. Get me those contracts, and we'll know exactly when and where to strike.

hook: We have tried peace. We have tried warnings. Nyx's corruption spreads like a disease, and we can no longer stand idle. End her threat to our sacred grove, and you will have earned the Circle's eternal gratitude.

hook: I've heard the dead are walking in Bleak Falls Barrow again. A Draugr Scourge leads them, and it's getting too close to the road. Kodlak would want us to protect the hold. Go there, put that Scourge back in its grave, and report back to me.

hook: My mother's silver ring is gone! I saw that pompous fool Nazeem eyeing it yesterday. I can't accuse him openly without proof, but if you could retrieve it for me, I'd be in your debt. Just be discreet about it.

hook: Ysolda's been moving goods for us, legitimate-like, but some independent bandits don't know who they're messing with. She needs protection on her route today. Keep her safe, and there's coin in it for you.

hook: That Imperial bootlicker Proventus keeps poisoning Balgruuf's mind against our cause. I need someone to teach him a lesson he won't forget. Bloody him up a bit, show him we're watching.

hook: Sabjorn thinks he can compete with Black-Briar Mead. I want his secret recipe. Break into his quarters, find his special honeycomb formula, and bring it to me. Don't get caught, and don't drink the merchandise.

The Dark Brotherhood only trusts their most capable members with this task.
hook: A contract has come in for Mercer Frey. The Guild Master of the Thieves Guild. He's a paranoid one, always watching his back. Killing him won't be easy, but the pay is substantial. Find him in the Ratway, end his miserable life, and report back to me.

hook: The winds speak of Ice Wraiths circling the shrine. Their cold essence blocks Azura's voice. I cannot leave my vigil, but you could. Clear them from the shrine so I may hear my lady once more.

description: Sapphire reveals that a bandit marauder stole a flawless sapphire from her years ago, a gem that holds the only clue to her family's identity. She's tracked the bandit to a hideout in the Ratway. She wants it back desperately, even if it means bloodshed.
hook: That sapphire is all I have of my family. Some bandit took it when I was just a girl. I've finally found where he's hiding in the Ratway. I don't care how you do it, just get my sapphire back.

hook: Rikke was once my friend. Now she's the Empire's sharpest blade against us. She knows our strategies, our weaknesses. She has to die. I can't send just anyone for this. You've proven yourself. End her, and return to me.

hook: Vesper, those blasted dire wolves have been getting bolder by the day. I'd deal with them myself, but the Council has me tied up with patrol routes. Think you could show those beasts the sharp end of your blade?

hook: Vance thinks he's clever, moving his pretty little pearls by land instead of sea to avoid my ships. What he doesn't know is that I have eyes everywhere. I need someone with a light step and sticky fingers. Get me those pearls, and there's a fat purse and my gratitude in it for you.

description: Morgana Dreadveil has a personal vendetta against Kaelen Silverwood. The elven ranger has disrupted too many Syndicate operations in the Silverwood, and Morgana wants him permanently removed. She's willing to pay handsomely and bring Vesper deeper into the Syndicate's confidence—but only if the job is done cleanly.
hook: Kaelen Silverwood. That name tastes like ash in my mouth. He's cost us thousands in lost shipments and dead operatives. The Syndicate has been patient, but my patience is gone. I need someone who can get close to him—someone he might trust, or at least not suspect. End him, and you'll have my personal gratitude and a place at my table. Are you ready to prove where your loyalties truly lie?

description: Percival Rustbucket has heard rumors that Mira Fireheart, an alchemist working with the Ironhold Conglomerate, has developed a revolutionary formula for stabilizing fire salts. That formula, written on a spell scroll, would be invaluable to Percival's own research. He wants it stolen.
hook: Mira's work on fire salt stabilization is years ahead of mine. I've tried to replicate it, but I'm missing something crucial. That scroll of hers contains the key. I'm not asking you to hurt anyone—just liberate a piece of paper from someone who doesn't deserve to have it. Think of it as... academic collaboration at a distance.

hook: Darius Black. That name is written in the blood of good men and women who died because he sold their patrol routes to the Syndicate. The Council wants justice—quietly. No diplomatic incidents, no escalation. Just one dead spy and a message sent. You've proven yourself trustworthy. Will you be our blade in the shadows?

hook: The skitterersss—they breed too fast. My hunting groundsss become dangerousss. I cannot track prey when I must watch every step for their venom. Clear them out, and I will share what I know of the marsh'ss secret pathsss. And pay you, of courssse.

The traitor fled into the Dreadmarsh but was reportedly killed by the restless dead there. The manifest—which contains sensitive trade route information—is still out there, likely in the possession of a drowned sailor.
hook: That manifest has every route, every cargo, every contact I've made in five years of sailing. If the Syndicate gets their hands on it, they'll own the Azure Coast trade. My man said the thief fled into the Dreadmarsh. Word is he didn't make it out. The manifest should still be on his corpse. Find it for me, and you'll have my eternal gratitude—and a share of my next cargo.

hook: Fergus found something big—a vein of iron that could keep our forges burning for a decade. Problem is, it's practically in the Embermaw Clan's backyard, and the place is crawling with nasties. We need someone to watch his back while he does the survey work. Interested?

description: Lyra Quickstep is furious with Penny Honeytongue. The halfling bard from Ravenport has been spreading scandalous rumors about Lyra's performances, claiming she uses enchanted instruments to enhance her music. Lyra wants Vesper to 'have a word' with Penny that leaves her less inclined to gossip.
hook: That two-faced, honey-tongued little liar! She's telling everyone I use enchanted lutes! Me! I've spent twenty years perfecting my craft, and she's ruining my reputation with one nasty rumor after another. I want you to find her and... convince her to retract her statements. A black eye might help her memory.

Vanya believes such an item belongs in the hands of a trained wizard, not a clan hunter. She wants Vesper to retrieve it, preferably without Ygritte noticing until it's too late.
hook: Frost mirrors are incredibly rare—only a handful were ever created, and most were lost in the great thaw. To think one is being used as a hunting tool by some clan barbarian! It's an insult to the arcane arts. I want that mirror brought to the Spire where it belongs. I don't care how you get it, but try not to start a war with the Embermaw Clan in the process.

hook: There's a wraith up here—cold as the grave and twice as hungry. It's been scaring off the game and nearly got one of my hunters last night. I've faced it before, but it's smart, and I can't track it and protect my people at the same time. Help me deal with it, and I'll share what I know about the peak's hidden passes.

The ring is more than valuable; it could be used to forge documents in his name. He needs it back before his reputation suffers.
hook: That ring has been in my family for six generations. Without it, I cannot seal official documents, and worse—someone else could. I've tracked it to a Syndicate safehouse in Ravenport. I cannot be seen retrieving it myself; it would look like weakness. But you... you could slip in and out like a shadow. Return my signet, and I will owe you a significant favor.

hook: Those drunken louts threatened my cousin Greta! Said they'd burn her inn down with her inside! The guards can't be there all night, but you could. Just be there, make sure they think twice if they show their ugly faces again. Greta's a good woman—doesn't deserve this trouble.

hook: That sniveling Raskul thinks he can just waltz into Ravenport and sell secrets to my contacts! He's Embermaw scum, and he needs to remember his place. Go find him and give him a beating he won't forget. Nothing fatal—I'm not trying to start a war. Just make sure he understands that Ravenport is my hunting ground.

hook: Jasper thinks he's the only one who deserves those orchids. He guards them like a dragon with gold. But I have clients who pay very well for certain... specialized concoctions, and I need those flowers. His garden is well-tended but poorly guarded. Should be simple enough for someone with your talents. Bring me his best orchids, and I'll make it worth your while.

The creature is now a threat to everything in its domain, attacking travelers and spreading blight. It must be destroyed before the corruption spreads further.
hook: She was once a guardian—a beautiful spirit who blessed our woods. Something twisted her. Now she spreads decay wherever her roots touch. I've tried cleansing rituals, but the corruption is too deep. She needs to be put down, for the safety of the forest and everyone in it. I cannot do it myself—my connection to the woods makes me vulnerable to her corruption. But you... you could end her suffering and save the grove.

hook: That cursed boar! Look what it's done to my barley field! My best crop, torn up like a dog's chew toy. And poor Timmins—it gored his leg something fierce. I'm just a farmer, not a hunter. Could you track it down and put an end to its rampage? I can pay, and you're welcome to as much pork as you can carry.

hook: Two months of work! Two months of forging blades and shaping armor, and some brainless cave troll makes off with the payment! My workers need their wages, and I need to buy more ore. I tracked the beast to a cave near Embermaw, but I'm a blacksmith, not a troll hunter. Get my coins back, and I'll forge you a blade worth more than the payment itself.

hook: Someone doesn't want Lily selling us feverfew and woundwort. We've had three guards fall ill in the past month, and her remedies are the only thing keeping them alive. The threats are anonymous, but the timing is suspicious. Watch over her shop for a few nights. If anyone shows up to make good on those threats, deal with them.

hook: Rook. That name curdles my ale. Fifteen years ago, he promised me a fair price for a shipment of star-metal ore. Instead, he paid me in counterfeit coins and sailed off laughing. I've waited a long time for payback. I can't go to Ravenport myself—too recognizable, and it'd cause a diplomatic incident. But you? You could find him and remind him that dwarves have long memories and longer grudges.

hook: Vivienne sits on a treasure trove of resonant crystals while my research stagnates. She claims they're 'too volatile' for my experiments, but the truth is she wants to publish her findings first and claim all the credit! Her chambers in the Spire are well-warded, but not impenetrable. A clever thief could acquire a few shards without her ever knowing they were gone. Help me advance magical knowledge—and get paid well in the process.

hook: Some fool wizard's old guardian woke up and decided the pass belongs to it now. We've lost two merchants already—had to turn back or take the long way around. The pass is vital to our trade with the Order. Go smash that walking rock pile, and the Conglomerate will be grateful.

hook: That map took me three years to compile. Every safe passage, every flooded chamber to avoid, every spot where the ancient ones left their treasures. Reed stole it from my quarters while I was meeting with Cyrus Vance. He's planning to beat me to the ruins. I need that map back. Get it for me, and I'll share whatever I find in the depths.

hook: Fizzwick's gadgets are going to make us a lot of money. Problem is, his business rival Grizzle knows about the deal and isn't happy about being cut out. We need someone to stand around and look threatening while Fizzwick finalizes the agreement. If Grizzle shows his face, convince him to leave. Permanently, if necessary.

The Dreadmarsh has enough for both of us, but Sszik acts like he owns every bog and fen. Go remind him that he shares the marsh with others. A few bruises should help him remember his manners.

hook: Vance has this wine—aged for a hundred years, from grapes that no longer grow anywhere in the world. A single bottle is worth more than most people make in a year. He has cases of it in his coastal villa. If I serve that at the party, my reputation will soar! I just need someone to liberate a few bottles. The villa's security is lax during the day. Interested?

It needs to go—further into the mountain, or just... gone. I can't approach it myself; my equipment would just make it more agitated. Can you handle it?

hook: That ring has been in my chapel for over a century. It's not just silver—it's been blessed by generations of priests, and it carries the prayers of thousands who found healing here. I saw that fae woman, Nyx, the day before it disappeared. She had a look about her. Please, find her and get my ring back. I don't want anyone hurt—I just want what's sacred returned.

The road is dangerous, and there are whispers that the Embermaw Clan might try to intercept her to prevent the alliance. The Council wants an escort who can handle combat if necessary.
hook: Elysia carries terms that could unite Silverwood and the Spire against any external threats—including the Embermaw Clan. They won't want that alliance to happen. We need someone watching her back who can handle more than just words. Get her to the Spire safely, and you'll have earned the Council's deep gratitude.

hook: Vivienne thinks her magic makes her untouchable. She's been identifying our people, feeding information to the Order, costing us coin and contacts. I want her to understand that she's not safe, that her tower walls won't protect her. A personal visit. A few bruises. A clear message: stay out of Syndicate business, or next time will be worse. Can you deliver it?

description: Bartholomew Reed has learned of a cache of ancient coins hidden in the Sunken Ruins, guarded by skeletal warriors. He wants that treasure, but he's not willing to risk his own neck in the dangerous ruins. He's offering a generous cut to anyone who can retrieve it.
hook: The old empire buried their dead with fortunes, and the Sunken Ruins are full of them. I've found references to a specific tomb—a minor noble, but rich enough to be worth our time. Problem is, the dead down there don't stay dead. Skeletons guard the place. Clear them out, grab the coins, and I'll split the take with you fifty-fifty. More coin than most see in a year.

hook: Those harpies have made the mountain path nearly impassable. Their screeching can deafen you, and their claws are sharp as razors. I've lost two good cloaks to them already. I'd deal with them myself, but I'm needed elsewhere. Could you thin their numbers a bit? Make the path safe again for travelers.

description: Cyrus Vance's personal shipping manifest—containing details of his private trade agreements—was stolen, and he suspects Cassian Vale, a rival ship captain with ties to the Silverwood Council. He needs it retrieved before his business secrets are exposed.
hook: That manifest details every private arrangement I've made over the past decade. Suppliers who give me preferential rates, buyers who pay above market for discretion, routes that avoid Syndicate waters. If it becomes public, my business empire crumbles. I believe Cassian Vale has it—he's always been jealous of my success. Retrieve it for me, and I'll ensure you never want for coin or connections again.

description: Milo Proudfoot has received threats after refusing to serve a group of rowdy mercenaries who were harassing his other patrons. They promised to return and 'teach him a lesson.' He needs someone to be at the inn when they come back.
hook: I've run this inn for fifteen years, and I've never been so scared in my own home. Those thugs—they said they'd burn the place down with me inside! The guards can't watch the inn every night, but maybe you could? Just be here, look intimidating, make them think twice. I'll make sure you eat and drink for free while you're here, and there's coin in it too.

hook: Seraphina gets all the best jobs. 'Seraphina is so skilled.' 'Seraphina never fails.' Meanwhile, I'm scraping by on petty theft while she swims in coin. I need her to have an... accident. Nothing permanent, just something that keeps her bedridden for a few weeks. Long enough for me to prove myself to the higher-ups. Interested in helping a thief catch a break?

description: Opal Stardust needs high-quality fire salts for an important alchemical experiment, but the best salts come from Embermaw, controlled by Mira Fireheart and the Ironhold Conglomerate. Since the Conglomerate and the Order are on neutral terms at best, Opal can't acquire them through official channels. She wants Vesper to 'borrow' some from Mira's stores.
hook: Mira's fire salts are the purest I've ever seen—the way she stabilizes them is remarkable. I need them for an experiment that could revolutionize how we store magical energy. But the Conglomerate won't sell to the Order directly, and Mira guards her salts like a dragon. I just need a few handfuls. Could you... acquire some for me? Quietly?

description: Greta Stonebrew's cousin was a fisherman who worked the waters near the Dreadmarsh. He recently disappeared, and the only trace found was evidence of deep one hybrids in the area. Greta wants someone to hunt down the creatures and make the waters safe again.
hook: My cousin Jurgen—good man, honest fisherman. Went out three weeks ago and never came back. The search party found his boat, torn apart, and those... things... lurking nearby. Fish-men, monsters from the deep. I want them dead. All of them you can find. For Jurgen, and for everyone else who makes their living on those waters. Can you do it?

description: Finnian Swift's prized lute was stolen while he was performing in Ravenport. He tracked it to a Syndicate safehouse, but he's no thief and can't retrieve it himself. The lute has sentimental value—it was a gift from his mentor—and he desperately wants it back.
hook: That lute has been with me through three kingdoms and a dozen broken hearts. My mentor carved it himself and taught me my first chords on it. I can't just buy another—it's irreplaceable. I know it's in a Syndicate safehouse near the docks. I can't go in there myself, but you... you move in those circles, don't you? Please, get it back for me. I'll pay whatever you ask.

description: Selene Starweaver, an elven wizard affiliated with both the Silverwood Council and the Order of the Spire, is conducting delicate research along the Azure Coast—research that certain parties would prefer remain incomplete. Madam Vivienne wants someone to ensure Selene's safety while she completes her work.
hook: Selene is on the verge of a breakthrough regarding the ancient magic that binds the coast's ley lines. There are those—I won't name names—who would prefer that knowledge remain buried. She's vulnerable while she works, lost in her calculations. Watch over her. Ensure no one interferes. The Order will remember this service.

hook: Nyx. That name burns like frost on my tongue. She stole a moonstone amulet from my mentor—an irreplaceable family heirloom—and sold it to some noble who's probably using it as a paperweight. My mentor died still mourning its loss. I can't get the amulet back, but I can make Nyx regret what she did. Find her, hurt her, and tell her Isolde Mistwalker sends her regards.

Lily refuses to sell to anyone associated with the Syndicate. Belladonna wants Vesper to acquire some of Lily's prized emberbloom without her knowledge.
hook: Lily's emberbloom is legendary—she's cultivated a strain that's twice as potent as the wild variety. I've tried to buy it legitimately, but she recognizes my Syndicate connections and refuses. Such prejudice! I need those flowers for a commission that pays very, very well. Her garden is peaceful but poorly secured. A few flowers won't be missed. Help me, and I'll share the profits.

Dropped my favorite pick—had it for twenty years—and a pouch of samples that could lead to a new vein. I'm not going back there alone. Clear those bone-walkers out for me, and I'll share whatever I find in that new vein. Deal?

Urgath Bonebreaker has been authorized to deal with the traitor permanently, and he's offering a significant reward to anyone willing to do the deed.
hook: Gorn Hammerfall. That dwarf has cost us good warriors. He pretends to be a simple miner, but he's Ironhold's eyes in our territory. Every time we move a hunting party, he reports it, and Ironhold's patrols just happen to be in the area. The Clan wants him dead. No warnings, no messages—just an end to his spying. You've killed for us before. This one pays better. Are you in?

hook: There's a rat in the walls of Port Vesper. A gnome named Kestrel. He's been feeding our secrets to the merchants. Silence him. Permanently. Do this, and you'll have my trust.

hook: A blight touches the wood, friend. Our sister Fiora goes to cleanse it, but the creatures of the blight will not make it easy. Go with her. Be her shield. Let nothing disturb the ritual.

hook: We've got greenskins sniffing around the eastern pass. They haven't attacked the walls yet, but they're making our patrols nervous. Go out there and bloody their noses a bit. Remind them why they should stay in the mountains.

hook: Lady Gwendolyn in Sunspear has a lovely little trinket. A silver necklace, quite old. I find myself wanting it. Retrieve it for me without causing a scene, and there's a purse of gold in it for you.

hook: That dog, Corvus. He's been a thorn in our side for too long. He's a killer for the Shadow Guild, hiding in their pit in Shadowmere. I want his head. You are one of the few I trust with this. Bring me proof of his demise, and you will be richly rewarded.

hook: The deeper woods are strangled by webs. The spiders are breeding out of control. I can't handle them all myself. Clear out the nest near the old watchtower. The forest will thank you.

description: Mira, the enchanter, had a sample ring stolen from her stall by a pickpocket she recognized as Lena, a member of the Shadow Guild. The ring wasn't highly valuable, but it's the principle of the thing. She wants it back to teach the thief a lesson.
hook: Can you believe the nerve? A girl, Lena, with shifty eyes, just snatched an enchanted ring right from under my nose! I heard she's hiding out in Verdantia. I don't want trouble with the Guild, but I want my property back. Can you retrieve it for me... discreetly?

hook: The Guildmaster wants Anya dead. She's too good at her job. This is your chance to prove you're one of us, through and through. Go to Stonewatch. End her watch. Permanently.

hook: See those reeds out there? Infested with goblins, they are. Nasty little blighters keep stealing my best eels! Scare 'em off for me, would ya? I'll make it worth your while.

hook: It's gone! The Pendant of Saint Aleena, a relic of our chapel, has been stolen. I fear it was that shadowy figure, Sable. Please, I beseech you, venture into their dark den and bring back our sacred symbol.

hook: Our shaman, Fenris, walks the shadowed paths of the Mistwood. He seeks a place of power. The wilds there do not respect our strength. You will go. You will be his shadow, his claw. See that he returns to us unharmed.

hook: It's been too quiet here. And that's bad for business. Word is there are bandits on the road from Riversend. Paying customers aren't getting through. Clear them out and I'll make sure you drink for free for a week.

hook: That gnome! He has a whole bushel of Moonpetal, just sitting there! He knows I need it for my stabilization formula. He's just being obstinate. Would you mind... slipping into his workshop and retrieving a bundle for me? Just a small one. He'll never miss it.

hook: There's a blasted troll under the East Bridge. Scaring the miners half to death and demanding their lunch. Go deal with it. A few good whacks with a sword should convince it to find a new home.

hook: Lady Isolde is on a mission of peace, but the roads are full of vipers. She refuses a large military escort as a sign of good faith. We need a single, reliable sword to see her safely to Verdantia. Can you be that sword?

hook: The dwarven smith. His hammer rings out, and our enemies grow stronger. The Clan has decreed his forge must fall silent. Go to Ironhold. Do what must be done. Report to Krag when the deed is finished.

hook: I was out gathering wild onions when one of them vines lashed out at me. Nasty, poisonous things. They're spreading near the old path. Someone's going to get hurt. Could you clear them out? Burn them, cut them down, just get rid of them.

hook: That scaly liar Orin has been poisoning my business deals. Telling everyone my ore is brittle. It's not! He needs a lesson in dwarven diplomacy. Find him on Drake Peak and give him a few bruises he won't soon forget. That'll shut his lying mouth.

hook: Morwen has something I need. A scroll. It's... not for the eyes of the Circle. She keeps it with her in Verdantia. Retrieve it for me, and I will reward you with artifacts of power. This must be our secret.

hook: We have a new target. A grand one. Eldrin of the Sylvan Circle. He's old, wise, and deadly. But he's not immortal. This is the big one. Bring me proof of his end, and your place in the Guild is assured.

hook: The spring near the Grey Rocks... it's fouled. Poisonous plants have choked its banks. The deer won't drink. The birds are silent. I need to know why, but first, the plants must be cleared. Help me with this, and the forest will be grateful.

hook: My prize ruby, gone! That weasel Garrick was sniffing around my shop. He's likely hiding in the Crimson Badlands. Get it back for me, and you'll have my gratitude and steel.

hook: Sera's in the city, and she's got a little letter on her that I'd very much like to read. She's sharp, but if you're quiet enough, you can relieve her of it. Bring it to me, and I'll make it worth your while.

hook: Once, she was a scholar of great promise. Now, she is a blight upon the woods. I have not the heart to face what she has become. I need someone to end her suffering and bring me proof it is done.

hook: Goblins! Nasty little buggers have overrun the path to the east vein. We can't get our ore out. Clear out a few of them, and we can handle the rest.

hook: It has been in my family for seven generations. It holds no value to a thief, but it is priceless to me. Please, if you can find this man Cyrus in Shadowmere and recover it, I will bless you with all I can offer.

hook: Lyra's potions keep our guardsmen alive. The Outriders know this. Escort her safely from Ravenwood to our gates, and see that no harm comes to her.

hook: Fenris is a brute, but he's predictable. He walks the same ridge every few days. Give him a beating he won't forget. It will make the Outriders think twice about pushing into our territories.

description: Vex, a halfling thief of the Circle of Whispers, has developed a taste for the famously potent Dwarven Ale brewed by Fizzwick at his inn in Ironpeak. Rather than pay for it, Vex wants you to sneak into Fizzwick's storeroom and liberate a few bottles for him.
hook: Have you tried Fizzwick's ale? It's liquid gold, I tell you. But the old halfling charges an arm and a leg. Be a dear and grab me a few bottles from his back room, would you?

hook: Kaelen's hands are soaked in the blood of my friends. I want him dead. Hunt him down in those blasted Badlands, bring me proof of his death, and you'll have earned a captain's deepest gratitude and a heavy purse.

hook: The spiders have become bold. I've found webs across the deer trails. Kill a couple of the big ones, and the rest should retreat deeper into the forest where they belong.

hook: Grunt the orc has my rubies. He's holed up in the Badlands, laughing at me. I don't care how you do it, but get my gems back. If Grunt ends up dead in the process, so much the better.

hook: Anya is one of our best, and this deal with the dwarves is crucial. Keep her safe on the road to Ironpeak. We can't afford any... incidents.

Reyna, a spy who works for the Iron Guard, has been feeding information to the guards that led to the arrest of several Circle operatives. Lilith wants Reyna convinced to keep her mouth shut, permanently if necessary, but a severe beating will suffice.
hook: That rat Reyna has been chirping to the tin cans in the Iron Guard. Go to Stonehaven and teach her the price of a loose tongue. I don't care if she lives or dies, as long as she learns to be silent.

hook: Bram's got a map that's worth more than he knows. It shows a new ore vein the dwarves are sitting on. Get that scroll from his house in Ironpeak, and we'll both profit nicely from the knowledge.

hook: A drake's been burning our lads and lasses out in the Badlands. The elders want it dead. Bring back its scales as proof, and Magnus will see you're paid a king's ransom. It won't be an easy fight.

hook: The restless dead are so inconsiderate. They wail and moan and interrupt my concentration. Drive a couple of those wraiths back into whatever void they crawled out of so I can get some work done.

hook: My lute! It's not just an instrument, it's my livelihood, my voice! I heard that scoundrel Nyx in Shadowmere was flashing it around. Please, I'm no thief or fighter. Get it back for me, and I'll compose a ballad in your honor!

hook: Fizzwick's got a batch of his finest ale waiting for me in Ironpeak. It's a long, lonely road for a fellow my size. Walk with me there and back, keep the wolves and worse at bay, and I'll share a few bottles with you.

She's received word that a cultist leader is currently hiding in Shadowmere, trying to decode one of the stolen scrolls. She wants someone to confront this cultist and convince them to cease their activities.
hook: These cultists have no respect for knowledge. They hoard and defile ancient texts. One of their ringleaders is in Shadowmere. Find them and make it clear that their thievery will not be tolerated. A sound thrashing should suffice.

hook: Kira's been a thorn in my side at the market. I want to knock her down a peg. Sneak onto her dock and grab her lucky fishing rod. Just for a few days. It'll drive her mad.

hook: This marauder calls himself 'The Bloody Axe'. He's been making our patrols' lives hell. The bounty is high, and the job is simple: go to the Badlands, find him, kill him, and report back to me with proof.

hook: Oh, those nasty rats! They've chewed through three of my best grain sacks. Could you be a dear and thin them out a bit? Just a few should send the rest scurrying back where they came from.

hook: Young Glimmer got separated from his crew in the Whispering Caverns. The lad's got spirit but not much sense for fighting. Go find him and bring him back to Ironpeak in one piece. His mother will be grateful.

hook: Kira has a rod that's worth ten times what she thinks. She won't part with it. I'm not asking her anymore. I'm asking you. Acquire it for me, and you'll be well compensated.

hook: My work! Years of research, stolen! That assassin Lilith took it. I'm no match for her. Please, if you can retrieve my scroll from her in Shadowmere, I will share the secrets of my craft with you.

hook: Someone's got it out for our horses. Brynn's on watch at the stables tonight, but she's alone. Go keep her company and keep an eye out. If anyone tries anything, you know what to do.

hook: Balthazar has been spreading lies about my research. I want him taught a lesson in humility. Find him in Shadowmere, rough him up a bit. Nothing fatal, just enough to make him a laughingstock.

hook: The dead are terribly possessive of their old things. The crypt I need to access is crawling with skeletons. Smash a few of them to dust, and I can finally get in to do my work.

hook: Morgana! It had to be her. She's taken my staff. Without it, my power is halved. Find her in Shadowmere. I don't care how you do it, but get my staff back. If she resists... well, she's an assassin, so I doubt she'll come quietly.

Elara, the scholar, has reason to believe it was taken by Seraphina, a wizard working for the Circle of Whispers, who was recently granted access to study it. hook: This is a delicate matter. A scroll of great historical significance is missing. We believe Seraphina, a respected wizard, may have... misplaced it to her own collection in Shadowmere.
